title: Biking Adventure · 5 days
metaDescription: This thrilling
overview: This thrilling

7-day cycling adventure begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where you’ll be transferred to your Hotel for a relaxing evening. On Day 2, your journey commences at Kilema Gate, cycling through dense rainforests and moorlands to reach Horombo Hut. Day 3 is dedicated to acclimatization as you cycle to Mawenzi Hut and back, allowing your body to adjust to the altitude. The following day, you’ll tackle the rugged terrain on your way to Kibo Hut, positioning you for the ascent.

The highlight of the trek occurs on Day 5 with a midnight ride to Uhuru Peak, where you can witness a breathtaking sunrise at the summit of Africa. After celebrating this incredible achievement, you’ll descend to Horombo Hut for rest. On Day 6, enjoy a scenic descent back to Kilema Gate, followed by a transfer to your Hotel.

Your adventure concludes on Day 7, with options to extend your trip by exploring the stunning island of Zanzibar or embarking on a safari tour, ensuring a memorable conclusion to your Kilimanjaro experience. For more details about this adventure, please visit our Safari page.

days.label: Arrival
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you’ll be greeted by our dedicated driver, who will be holding a sign with your name, ensuring a warm and personal welcome. After this friendly introduction, you’ll enjoy a seamless transfer to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you. Once settled, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, providing essential information about your upcoming expedition and the breathtaking experiences that lie ahead.

While at your Hotel, you’ll have the opportunity to unwind in a relaxing environment that features a swimming pool, beautiful gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. This tranquil setting is perfect for preparing for your adventure, allowing you to refresh and recharge before your trek begins. The hotel’s amenities enhance your stay, ensuring you are comfortable and ready for the journey ahead.

days.label: Marangu/Kilema Gate to Horombo Hut

stats.Altitude: Start at 1,800 meters at Kilema Gate and reach 3,720 meters at Horombo Hut.

text: Cycling Distance: Approximately 19 km.
Cycling Time: 5 to 6 hours, depending on the terrain and weather conditions.

Kick off your adventure with a morning pickup from your Hotel at 8:30 am. The day begins with a scenic drive through the semi-tropical foothills, leading you to Marangu Gate for registration. After obtaining the necessary permits, you’ll transfer to Kilema Gate to commence your cycling expedition.

As you enter Kilimanjaro National Park, you’ll bike through lush rainforests, immersing yourself in the vibrant greenery, fresh air, and the enchanting sounds of the forest. The thrill of cycling through this unique terrain brings you closer to Kilimanjaro’s diverse ecosystems as you ascend towards Horombo Hut, surrounded by towering trees and a variety of wildlife. This journey offers an exhilarating introduction to the mountain’s breathtaking landscapes, setting an exciting tone for the adventures that lie ahead.

days.label: Full Day Horombo Acclimatization
text: Cycling Distance: 10 km
Cycling Time: 3–4 hours

After breakfast, embark on an acclimatization day by cycling through the Alpine desert towards Mawenzi Hut. The terrain gradually transforms into rockier paths, featuring loose stones and rugged sections, challenging you as you ascend. This ride not only offers breathtaking views of Mawenzi Peak but also provides sweeping vistas of the high-altitude desert landscape, making it a visually stunning part of your journey. Navigating this uneven terrain is crucial for acclimatization, as it helps your body adapt to the increasing elevation.

Once you reach Mawenzi Hut, take a moment to appreciate the scenery before starting your descent back to Horombo Hut. This route is instrumental in enhancing your chances of a successful summit by allowing your body to adjust to the altitude while delivering an exhilarating experience in Kilimanjaro’s remote environment. After a rewarding day of cycling, enjoy a restful evening back at Horombo, reflecting on the day’s achievements and preparing for the next leg of your adventure.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
text: Cycling Distance: 9 km
Cycling Time: 4–5 hours

After a hearty breakfast, resume your journey towards Kibo Hut, riding along a desert landscape characterized by small stones and loose gravel paths. This segment of the trail demands both focus and endurance as you ascend higher through Kilimanjaro’s rugged terrain. As you pedal, the vegetation gradually diminishes, leaving behind the stark beauty of the alpine desert. You’ll be enveloped by vast, barren landscapes, complemented by stunning views of the towering peaks above.

This day’s ride brings you closer to the summit base camp, where you’ll notice the air becoming thinner and the temperature dropping significantly. Upon arriving at Kibo Hut, enjoy an early dinner and take the time to rest, mentally preparing yourself for the final ascent to the summit. As night falls, take a moment to appreciate the serene beauty of the stars shining brightly above, marking the culmination of your incredible journey thus far.

days.label: Kibo Hut – Summit (5,895 m) – Horombo Hut (3,720 m)

stats.Altitude: 4,703 m to 5,895 m (Uhuru Peak) and back to 3,720 m

text: Cycling Distance: 15 km
Cycling Time: 8–10 hours

Begin your summit attempt at 11:00 PM, starting with a steep trek up a zigzag path to Gilman’s Point. This initial ascent is physically demanding but essential for acclimatization. Upon reaching Gilman’s Point, switch to your bike and carefully ride along the rocky trail to Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), the highest point in Africa. This section requires concentration, as the terrain can be challenging. As you approach the summit, be prepared to be rewarded with breathtaking views of the sunrise, an unforgettable moment that you’ll want to capture in photos.

After a brief celebration at the summit, it’s time to start your descent. Cycle back down to Stella Point, then continue to Kibo Hut for a quick lunch and a short rest. After your break, ride further down to Horombo Hut. This day is long and challenging, but the sense of accomplishment and the stunning vistas make it an unforgettable experience that is truly worth every effort. Enjoy the rewarding feeling of completing your climb as you reflect on the incredible journey you’ve undertaken.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Kilema Gate to Moshi
text: Cycling Distance: 19 km
Cycling Time: 4–5 hours

After breakfast, begin a leisurely descent through the scenic moorland, cycling down to Kilema Gate. Enjoy the diverse vegetation and keep an eye out for wildlife as you make your way to lower altitudes, where the air becomes warmer and the surroundings more vibrant. This smooth ride allows you to fully appreciate the natural beauty of Kilimanjaro’s lower slopes, providing a tranquil end to your adventure.

Upon reaching Kilema Gate, complete the final check-out procedures before being transferred to Marangu Gate, where you’ll officially conclude your Kilimanjaro journey. A driver will then take you back to your Hotel, where you can relax and enjoy a well-deserved rest. Take this time to celebrate your incredible achievements and reflect on the unforgettable experiences from your trek.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary. This is a fantastic way to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture; more details can be found on our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you may choose to continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or looking to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page for the perfect package tailored to your next excursion. If you’re interested in a safari experience, check out our Safari page for more information on exciting options available to enhance your travel experience.

title: Lemosho Route · 7 days
metaDescription: Embark on a remarkable adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your Hotel. Here, you’ll receive a detailed briefing
overview: Embark on a remarkable adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your Hotel. Here, you’ll receive a detailed briefing from our experienced guides, setting the stage for your trek. Enjoy the hotel’s amenities, including a pool, garden, bar, and restaurant, ensuring a comfortable start to your journey.

The trek kicks off with a drive to Lemosho Park Gate, where you’ll register before hiking through lush forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Camp. Over the following days, you’ll ascend through stunning landscapes, including Shira 1 and Shira 2 camps, the Lava Tower, and the famous Barranco Wall. Each day offers new challenges and breathtaking views, culminating in the summit attempt to Uhuru Peak.

After reaching the peak, you’ll descend to Mweka Camp and return to your Hotel for a hot meal and a chance to reflect on your achievement. Optional extensions include safaris and visits to Zanzibar, allowing further exploration of Tanzania’s diverse beauty.
This journey combines adventure with the opportunity to experience the breathtaking landscapes and rich culture of Tanzania, ensuring a memorable trip for every climber

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name for a warm welcome. From there, you will enjoy a seamless and comfortable transfer to your Hotel.

Upon arrival, you’ll be served a delicious meal to replenish your energy. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will provide a pre-trekking briefing, offering valuable insights into the wonders that await you on your expedition.
Take the time to relax in the inviting atmosphere of your Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring a pleasant start to your adventure.

days.label: Moshi - Lemosho Park Gate - Mti Mkubwa Camp
text: On your first day, after enjoying breakfast and attending a briefing with your guide at your Hotel, you’ll be transferred to Lemosho Park Gate (2,100m), a scenic 1.5-hour drive. At Londorossi Gate, you’ll complete the necessary registration before embarking on your trek.

The hike along picturesque forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Campsite (2,750m) typically takes around 3 hours. Upon your arrival, the porters will set up your tents, and our chef will prepare a hearty lunch for you to enjoy. After your meal, you’ll have some free time to relax and acclimatize before dinner.
In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you are well-prepared for the adventure ahead.

days.label: Mti Mkubwa Camp | Shira Camp 2
text: Begin your day with an early breakfast before setting out on your trek from Mti Mkubwa Camp. The trail will lead you through diverse landscapes, including lush moorlands and stunning views of Kibo Volcano. You’ll hike for approximately 5 hours, reaching Shira Camp 1, where a hot lunch prepared by our chef awaits you.

After your meal, continue the trek to Shira Camp 2, which is about 2-3 hours away. This campsite is located at a higher altitude, providing expansive views of the surrounding landscapes. Upon arrival, our porters will set up your tents, and you’ll have time to relax and acclimatize before dinner.
In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing on the following day’s trek, ensuring you are well-prepared for the adventure ahead.

days.label: Shira Camp 2 | Barranco Camp
text: Start the day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route includes a climb to the Lava Tower at 4,630 meters, passing through a semi-desert, rocky landscape.

After approximately 5 hours of hiking, enjoy a well-deserved lunch before ascending the rocky scree path to the Lava Tower. This demanding day might test your endurance as you adjust to the higher altitude. After lunch, you’ll descend 680 meters to the Barranco Camp, where the true benefit of acclimatization becomes clear.

The 2-hour descent offers stunning photo opportunities of the Western Breach, a notable feature of Kilimanjaro’s landscape. End the day with a memorable sunset and a delicious dinner at Barranco Camp, where you can relax and reflect on the day’s adventures before preparing for the next leg of your journey.

days.label: Barranco Camp | Karanga Camp
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s adventure involves ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that offers stunning views of the surrounding landscapes. Once you conquer the Wall, you’ll descend into the picturesque Karanga Valley, known for its lush vegetation and breathtaking scenery. Upon reaching the Karanga Camp, our dedicated porters will set up the tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch for you.
After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to Karanga Camp. This hike is crucial for your body’s adjustment to the altitude.

In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, and after dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and essential details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the upcoming adventure.

days.label: Karanga Camp | Barafu Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu Camp. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, providing breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s essential to focus on acclimatization to avoid altitude-related issues. Upon reaching Barafu Camp, our porters will efficiently handle the camp setup while the chef prepares a delicious lunch for you.

After enjoying your meal, take some time to rest and recharge until dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt, covering critical aspects such as the route, challenges, safety measures, and preparations to ensure you are ready for this significant part of your journey. Try to rest well tonight, as the summit ascent begins late in the evening, requiring your full energy and focus.

days.label: Summit Day | Barafu Camp | Uhuru Peak
text: You’ll rise around 11:30 PM and start your ascent after a light meal of tea and biscuits. Heading northwest, you’ll climb through scree towards Stella Point on the crater rim. This challenging 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5,685m) is often the most mentally and physically demanding part of the climb.

After a brief rest at Stella Point, if weather conditions allow, you’ll be treated to a stunning sunrise. From Stella Point, it’s a 2-hour snow-covered ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point on Kilimanjaro.

Your time at the summit will depend on the weather, so it’s important not to linger too long due to the cold and fatigue. The descent to Barafu Camp takes approximately 3 hours, where you can take a short rest before continuing on to Mweka Camp for dinner and an overnight stay, reflecting on your incredible achievement.

days.label: Mweka Camp | Moshi
text: After breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where your adventure concludes. A comfortable drive will take you back to Moshi, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you, providing a well-deserved opportunity to relax.

At the end of your trip, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel. If you wish to extend your adventure with a safari, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, the coordinator will provide a briefing on various safari options available.
We highly recommend booking a safari with us to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty, making your journey truly unforgettable.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you will be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in the local culture. For more information, you can check our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you might want to continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Discover the perfect package for your next excursion by exploring our Zanzibar page.
If you’re also interested in adding a safari experience, please visit our Safari page for more details about our exciting safari options.

title: Londorossi Route · 7 days
metaDescription: Your adventure begins upon arrival at
overview: Your adventure begins upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where our driver will warmly greet you and transfer you to your Hotel. After enjoying a delightful meal and a pre-trekking briefing from your guide and mountain coordinators, you can relax and take advantage of the hotel’s amenities, including the swimming pool, garden, and restaurant.

The following day, you’ll drive to Londorossi Park Gate to start your hike to Shira 1 Camp. Over the next few days, you’ll trek through stunning landscapes, including the ascent of the Barranco Wall and the Lava Tower, before reaching Barafu Camp, where you’ll prepare for the summit attempt.

On Day 7, you’ll rise early for the challenging summit ascent to Uhuru Peak, experiencing a breathtaking sunrise before descending to Mweka Camp. After completing the climb, you’ll return to Mweka Gate and transfer back to Sal salinero Hotel for a hot meal and refreshing shower.

To extend your adventure, you can opt for a safari or explore Zanzibar’s beautiful beaches and rich culture. For more information, please visit our Day Trip and Safari pages, or check out our Zanzibar options for additional excursions.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for easy identification. This seamless and comfortable transfer service will take you to the charming Hotel.

At the hotel, you will be welcomed with a delicious meal. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This is an exciting opportunity to learn about the upcoming adventure and the wonders that await you on your trek.
Take advantage of the relaxing environment at the Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring you start your journey on a comfortable note.

days.label: Moshi to Londorossi Gate then Shira 1

stats.Altitude: 890 meters (2,920 feet) - 3,505 meters (11,500 feet) above sea level.

text: After enjoying breakfast at Hotel and receiving essential instructions from your guide, you’ll embark on a 1.5-hour drive to Londorossi Park Gate (2250m). Following your guide’s advice is crucial for avoiding altitude sickness, as you’ll be climbing to significant elevations, with your first night at Shira 1 Camp.

At Londorossi Gate, you’ll complete a brief registration before entering the national park. Following this, you’ll have a short drive along Shira Road to the Moram Picnic Site, which takes about 45 minutes. From there, you’ll start your 7 km hike to Shira 1 Camp, typically taking 3 to 4 hours depending on your pace. You’ll have a restful overnight stay at Shira 1, preparing for the next day’s trek to Shira 2 Camp.
This day sets the tone for your journey, allowing you to acclimatize while enjoying the stunning scenery along the way.

days.label: Trek from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp
text: On this day, you’ll wake up early for breakfast before starting the brief hike from Shira 1 to Shira 2 Camp. This trek typically takes 5 to 6 hours and is considered relatively easy, allowing you to take in the breathtaking views of the African landscape.

Upon reaching the Shira 2 campsite, our dedicated porters will handle all arrangements, including pitching tents while our chef prepares your lunch. After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some time to unwind and rest until dinnertime.
In the evening, after dinner, our experienced guide will brief you about the trekking plans for the following day, ensuring you are well-prepared for the next leg of your adventure.
This day is perfect for acclimatization and enjoying the spectacular surroundings, making it a memorable part of your Kilimanjaro journey.

days.label: Trek from Shira 2 Camp to Barranco Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route includes a climb to Lava Tower at 4,630m, where you’ll pass through a semi-desert, rocky landscape. After a 5-hour hike, you’ll enjoy lunch at Lava Tower, giving you a chance to recharge before ascending the rocky scree path. This demanding day might test your endurance as you acclimatize to the higher altitude.

Following lunch, you’ll descend 680m to Barranco Camp, where you’ll truly experience the benefits of acclimatization. This 2-hour descent offers stunning photo opportunities of the Western Breach, a dramatic cliff face that adds to the day’s breathtaking scenery. End the day with a memorable sunset and dinner at Barranco Camp, surrounded by the incredible landscapes that make your Kilimanjaro adventure truly unforgettable.
This day is designed to help you acclimatize properly while enjoying the stunning beauty of the mountain.

days.label: Trek from Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s journey may involve ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that offers spectacular views as you climb. After conquering the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic Karanga Valley, known for its lush vegetation and breathtaking landscapes. This descent allows for beautiful photo opportunities while you take in the stunning surroundings.

Upon reaching the Karanga campsite, our dedicated porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch for you. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to camp. This acclimatization effort is essential to prepare your body for the higher altitudes ahead. In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, providing you with the energy needed for the next day’s challenges. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the adventure that lies ahead.
This day is crucial for acclimatization and serves as a perfect balance of challenging ascents and well-deserved relaxation amidst nature’s beauty.

days.label: Trek from Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu campsite. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, providing breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s crucial to focus on acclimatization to avoid altitude-related issues, which can impact your trekking experience significantly. Upon reaching Barafu, our porters will efficiently handle camp setup while our chef prepares a nutritious lunch to replenish your energy. After eating, take some time to rest and prepare mentally and physically for the challenges ahead.

In the evening, your guide will conduct a detailed briefing on the upcoming summit attempt, covering the route, challenges, safety measures, and essential preparations to ensure your success. This is a vital moment to clarify any questions you may have and to solidify your plans for the summit.

Try to rest well during the day, as the summit ascent will begin late in the evening, and a good night’s sleep will be crucial for your performance during this critical stage of your adventure.This day is pivotal for building the stamina and mental strength needed for the final climb, and every effort you make here will contribute to your success on the summit.

days.label: Summit Attempt - Uhuru Peak
text: You’ll rise around 11:30 PM to begin your ascent after enjoying some tea and biscuits. The trek will lead you northwest as you climb through scree towards Stella Point on the crater rim. This 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5685m)

is often considered the most mentally and physically challenging part of the climb, testing your endurance and determination. After a brief rest at Stella Point, you will be rewarded with a magnificent sunrise, weather permitting, as you take in the stunning views. From Stella Point, you will embark on a 2-hour ascent across a snow-covered path to Uhuru Peak, the highest point on Mount Kilimanjaro.

Be mindful that your time at the summit may be limited due to cold temperatures and fatigue, so it’s important not to linger too long. The descent back to Barafu Camp takes about 3 hours, where you will have a short rest before continuing your journey to Mweka Camp for dinner and an overnight stay.
This day is the culmination of your efforts and will offer unforgettable views and a sense of achievement as you stand atop Africa’s highest peak.

days.label: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
text: After enjoying breakfast at Mweka Camp, you will begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where your trek concludes. Following the completion of your hike, a transfer will take you back to your Hotel, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you, providing the perfect opportunity to relax and celebrate your accomplishment.

As your trip comes to an end, please consider showing your appreciation to the trekking team with a tip. Special envelopes for this purpose are available at the hotel, ensuring that your gratitude reaches those who supported you on your journey.

If you wish to extend your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, they will provide a briefing on various safari options available, allowing you to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty. We highly recommend booking a safari with us, as it will truly make your journey unforgettable.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. This is a great time to reflect on your incredible journey and the unforgettable experiences you’ve had in Tanzania. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary, where you can explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. More details can be found on our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you may wish to continue your travels with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or an exploration of the island’s vibrant culture, Zanzibar has something for every traveler. For more information on the perfect package for your next excursion, visit our Zanzibar page. You can also consider booking a safari to experience Tanzania’s renowned wildlife. Our Safari page offers detailed information on various options, ensuring you capture the breathtaking natural beauty and wildlife that this incredible country has to offer.

title: Machame Route · 6 days

overview: This package provides an all-encompassing adventure, beginning with your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where you’ll receive a warm welcome and be transferred to your Hotel. There, you will savor a delicious meal and participate in a pre-trekking briefing led by our experienced coordinators to prepare you for the journey ahead.

The trek commences with a journey from Moshi to Machame Camp, where you’ll traverse lush rainforests and ascend to higher elevations. Each day introduces you to diverse terrains, from the moorlands of Shira Camp to the rocky landscapes surrounding Lava Tower and Barranco Camp. Throughout the trek, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to acclimatize and take in the breathtaking scenery, supported by our team dedicated to ensuring your comfort and safety.

The pinnacle of the trek is the ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa, where you’ll feel the exhilarating thrill of standing at the summit. Following your achievement, the descent leads you back through Kilimanjaro’s varied landscapes, culminating in a restful stay at Sal salinero Hotel.

For those eager to extend their adventure, there are options to explore Tanzania’s remarkable wildlife on a safari or to relax on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar. This package is thoughtfully crafted to deliver a well-rounded and unforgettable experience, blending the physical challenges of the climb with opportunities to unwind and appreciate the stunning beauty of Tanzania.

days.label: Arrival
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, a dedicated driver will be there to warmly welcome you, holding a sign with your name. From the airport, you’ll enjoy a smooth and comfortable transfer to your Hotel. Once you arrive at the hotel, a delicious meal will be served to you.

Later, you’ll meet with our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide for a pre-trekking briefing, providing you with an exciting overview of the adventures that await you on your upcoming expedition.
Take some time to relax at the Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, all designed to enhance your comfort and enjoyment during your stay.

days.label: Moshi to Machame Camp
text: After a hearty breakfast and a final briefing at your hotel, you’ll set off on a scenic 45-minute drive from Moshi to the Machame Park Gate. Upon arrival, the registration process will be completed, and you’ll receive a packed lunch for the journey ahead. The adventure begins as you trek into the lush rainforest, a region that can be muddy and slippery if it has rained recently, adding an extra layer of challenge to your ascent.

Covering approximately 11 km, the trek typically takes about six hours to reach Machame Camp. In the evening, porters will provide freshly boiled drinking and washing water while the cook prepares a warm dinner. As the night sets in, temperatures may drop to freezing, making it a chilly but fulfilling end to a rewarding day. You’ll then retire to your tent for a well-deserved rest, ready to continue the journey.

days.label: Machame Camp to Shira Camp
text: After a satisfying breakfast at Machame Camp, you’ll begin your trek toward Shira Camp. This hike spans approximately 5 km and typically takes around 4 to 5 hours. The journey starts with a steep ascent through the moorland zone, where you’ll be treated to spectacular views as you climb. As you near Shira Camp, the trail leads you along a ridge that offers breathtaking panoramas of the surrounding landscape.

Upon reaching Shira Camp, our dedicated porters will have set up the tents and prepared a hearty lunch for you. This will give you a chance to relax and acclimate to the altitude before dinner. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the plans for the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventures that lie ahead.

days.label: Shira Camp to Lava Tower to Barranco Camp

stats.Altitude: 3,840 meters (12,598 feet) - 4,630 meters (15,190 feet) - 3,960 meters (12,992 feet)

text: After enjoying breakfast at Shira Camp, you will set out on a demanding trek to Lava Tower, which stands at an altitude of 4,630 meters. This journey covers about 11 km and typically takes between 7 to 8 hours, traversing rocky, semi-desert terrain. Along the way, you will have the opportunity to savor a lunch with panoramic views at Lava Tower before making your descent to Barranco Camp, located at 3,960 meters.

The descent to Barranco Camp lasts approximately 2 hours and offers stunning vistas of the Western Breach, a prominent feature of Kilimanjaro’s landscape. Once you arrive at Barranco Camp, the team will set up your tents and prepare a delicious dinner. Later in the evening, your guide will brief you on the plans for the following day’s trek, ensuring you are well-prepared for the adventures that await you.
This stage of the trek is crucial for acclimatization, as the varying altitudes and terrains contribute to your overall experience on Kilimanjaro.

days.label: Barranco Camp | Karanga Camp | Barafu Camp
text: After an early breakfast, your day will begin with the challenge of ascending the renowned Barranco Wall, a steep climb that rewards you with breathtaking views. Upon reaching the top, you’ll descend into the vibrant Karanga Valley, where you’ll enjoy lunch at Karanga Camp. Following a brief rest, you’ll continue your trek towards Barafu Camp, navigating through diverse terrains and stunning landscapes.

When you arrive at Barafu Camp, the porters will set up the tents while you take some time to rest and savor a delicious dinner prepared by our chef. In the evening, your guide will provide important information regarding your upcoming summit attempt. It’s essential to get plenty of rest, as the final ascent will commence later that night.
This portion of the trek is not only physically demanding but also offers spectacular views and a unique opportunity for acclimatization as you prepare for the challenge ahead.

days.label: BARAFU CAMP | SUMMIT | MWEKA CAMP
text: You’ll wake up around 11:30 PM to begin your ascent, starting with some tea and biscuits for energy. The climb heads northwest through scree towards Stella Point, located on the crater rim. This 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5,685 meters) is often the most mentally and physically demanding part of the climb. After a brief rest, you may witness a spectacular sunrise, weather permitting.

From Stella Point, it’s a further 2-hour ascent over snow to Uhuru Peak. However, be mindful of the weather conditions and fatigue, as your time at the summit should be limited. After enjoying the views, you’ll begin your descent to Barafu Camp, which takes about 3 hours for a short rest. Finally, you’ll continue down to Mweka Camp for dinner and an overnight stay.

This section of the trek is crucial for acclimatization and requires both mental and physical preparation. The breathtaking views and the accomplishment of reaching the summit will make all the effort worthwhile!

days.label: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
text: After enjoying breakfast at Mweka Camp, you will begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where you will drive back to the Hotel. At the hotel, you’ll be treated to a hot lunch and a refreshing shower to unwind after your trek. Tipping your support team is encouraged, and special envelopes are available at the hotel for this purpose.

If you’re looking to extend your adventure, our safari coordinator will be on hand to discuss various safari options available. After some rest, you can receive a briefing on exciting opportunities to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty. Booking a safari with us is highly recommended for an unforgettable journey!

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re interested in extending your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, please visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can embark on a journey to the beautiful island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar offers something for everyone. Check out our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.
If a safari experience piques your interest, please visit our Safari page for more information about the exciting safari options we offer.

title: Marangu Route · 5 days

overview: This package offers an exhilarating adventure for those eager to conquer Africa’s tallest peak, Mount Kilimanjaro. Your journey begins upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where a warm welcome from our driver sets the tone for your experience. You will be transferred to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits, along with a pre-trekking briefing from our experienced coordinators to prepare you for the adventure ahead.

The trek commences from Moshi, taking you through the breathtaking landscapes of Kilimanjaro. You’ll start in the lush rainforest and gradually ascend to higher altitudes, allowing for acclimatization at various camps along the way. The pinnacle of this journey is the ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa.

Following this incredible achievement, the descent offers one last chance to appreciate the diverse scenery. After completing the trek, you will return to Sal salinero Hotel for a well-deserved rest. For those looking to extend their adventure, we offer options for safaris or relaxing beach stays in Zanzibar, creating a comprehensive Tanzanian experience.
If you want more information about the trek or any extension options, feel free to check out our detailed packages on our website.

days.label: Arrival
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be greeted by our dedicated driver, who will be holding a sign with your name, ready to offer a warm welcome. You will then enjoy a comfortable transfer to your Hotel, where you can unwind and indulge in a delicious meal. After settling in, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you the chance to learn about the exciting expedition that lies ahead.

At your Hotel, you can relax in a serene environment featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, and an inviting bar and restaurant. This tranquil setting is the perfect place to prepare for your adventure, ensuring you are well-rested and ready for the journey to conquer Mount Kilimanjaro.

days.label: Moshi to Marangu Gate | Mandara Hut
text: After enjoying a hearty breakfast, you will embark on your adventure with a one-hour drive from Moshi to the Marangu Gate. At the gate, you’ll complete the necessary registration formalities before beginning your trek through the lush rainforest. The path to Mandara Hut, your first campsite, features a steady uphill hike, where you may have the chance to spot monkeys and other wildlife.

Upon your arrival at Mandara, a warm meal will await you, and you will be accommodated in comfortable A-frame huts. In the evening, you have the option to take a short acclimatization hike to Maundi Crater, which provides stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. This initial trek sets the tone for your Kilimanjaro adventure, blending beautiful scenery with opportunities to adjust to the altitude.

days.label: Mandara Hut to Horombo Hut
text: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at Mandara Hut before continuing your trek through the lush rainforest, transitioning into the moorland zone. As you ascend, you’ll notice a gradual change in the vegetation, giving way to a more rugged and open landscape. The 6-hour trek to Horombo Hut promises stunning views of the Kibo and Mawenzi peaks along the way.

Upon your arrival at Horombo, a warm meal will greet you, providing the perfect opportunity to relax and acclimate to the higher altitude. In the evening, your guide will conduct a briefing for the next day’s trek, ensuring you are well-prepared for the challenges that lie ahead. This structure not only aids acclimatization but also fosters a sense of camaraderie and readiness among the group, enhancing your overall experience on this magnificent journey.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
text: Today’s trek takes you across the expansive lunar desert known as the “Saddle,” a stark and rugged landscape nestled between the Kibo and Mawenzi peaks. Although the terrain is desolate, the awe-inspiring views of the towering peaks on either side create a breathtaking backdrop for your hike. Expect to spend about 6 hours on this section of the journey, which allows ample time to appreciate the vastness of the landscape and the unique beauty of the surroundings.

Upon your arrival at Kibo Hut, you’ll settle in for an early dinner to help conserve your energy for the upcoming summit attempt. In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing to prepare you for the final ascent, scheduled to begin just before midnight. This preparation is crucial as it sets the stage for a successful summit experience, ensuring that you’re well-informed and mentally ready for the challenges that lie ahead.

days.label: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut
text: Around midnight, you’ll awaken to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. This segment of the climb, leading to Gillman’s Point at 5,685 meters, is steep and demanding, typically taking about six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will truly test your endurance, but your guide will be there to offer support and encouragement throughout the journey.

Upon reaching Gillman’s Point, you’ll have the opportunity to traverse the crater rim towards Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If conditions allow, you’ll be treated to a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, making this moment even more memorable. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll begin your descent to Kibo Hut for a brief rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night. This part of the trek offers a chance to reflect on your journey and the stunning landscapes you’ve experienced.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
text: After breakfast, you’ll begin your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. As you trek downward, take a moment to enjoy the final views of the stunning landscapes and reflect on your remarkable achievement. title: Marangu Route · 6 days
metaDescription: This package offers an exhilarating experience for those looking to conquer Africa’s tallest peak, starting with your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. Upon landing, you’ll be warmly greeted by our driver, who will transfer you
overview: This package offers an exhilarating experience for those looking to conquer Africa’s tallest peak, starting with your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. Upon landing, you’ll be warmly greeted by our driver, who will transfer you to your Hotel. Here, you’ll enjoy a delicious meal and a pre-trekking briefing led by our experienced coordinators, who will prepare you for the adventure ahead. The trek begins from Moshi, taking you through the stunning landscapes of Kilimanjaro, starting in the lush rainforest and progressing to higher altitudes as you make your way toward the summit.

Each day, you’ll acclimate at various camps, with our team ensuring your safety and comfort throughout the journey.The ultimate highlight of the trek is the ascent to Uhuru Peak, where you’ll stand at the highest point in Africa. After achieving this incredible feat, the descent allows you to take in the diverse scenery one last time.

Upon completing the trek, you’ll return to Sal salinero Hotel for a well-deserved rest. For those wishing to extend their journey, options for a safari or beach relaxation in Zanzibar can be added, creating a complete and unforgettable Tanzania adventure. For more information about the trek and additional options, feel free to explore our website.

days.label: Arrival
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for a personal touch. You will then enjoy a seamless transfer to the enchanting to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you. Following this, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you valuable insights into the wonders that lie ahead during your expedition.

Take the time to unwind and enjoy the relaxing environment of your Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This setting provides the perfect opportunity to prepare for your upcoming adventure while ensuring your comfort and relaxation before you begin your trek.

days.label: Moshi to Marangu Gate | Mandara Hut
text: After breakfast, your adventure begins with a 1-hour drive from Moshi to the Marangu Gate, where you’ll complete the necessary registration formalities. Once the paperwork is done, you’ll embark on your trek through the lush rainforest. The trail to Mandara Hut, your first camp, involves a steady uphill hike, providing opportunities to spot playful monkeys and various wildlife along the way.

Upon reaching Mandara, you’ll be welcomed with a warm meal and settle into comfortable A-frame huts for the night. In the evening, you can opt for a short acclimatization hike to Maundi Crater, where you can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. This hike not only aids in acclimatization but also allows you to soak in the beauty of your surroundings before continuing your trek .

days.label: Mandara Hut to Horombo Hut
text: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at Mandara Hut, fueling up for the exciting trek ahead. As you continue your journey, you’ll traverse through the lush rainforest before transitioning into the moorland zone. The ascent showcases a gradual change in vegetation, giving way to a more rugged and open landscape. This 6-hour trek to Horombo Hut offers stunning views of both Kibo and Mawenzi peaks, making it a memorable leg of your adventure.

Upon arrival at Horombo Hut, you’ll be greeted with a warm meal, giving you the chance to relax and acclimate to the higher altitude. In the evening, your guide will provide a comprehensive briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring that you’re well-prepared for the challenges ahead. This preparation is key to successfully navigating the upcoming stages of your climb.

days.label: Acclimatization Day at Horombo Hut
text: To assist with acclimatization, you’ll spend an extra day at Horombo Hut, allowing your body more time to adjust to the increasing altitude. This crucial acclimatization day provides the option to either relax at the camp or embark on a short hike to Zebra Rocks, a striking geological feature situated at 3,980 meters above sea level. This acclimatization hike is designed to help your body better cope with the upcoming higher elevations, significantly reducing the risk of altitude sickness.

After your hike, you’ll return to camp for a hearty meal, providing you with the energy needed for the next stages of your journey. In the evening, you’ll have the opportunity to discuss the plans for the next day’s ascent with your guide, ensuring that you’re fully prepared for the challenges ahead. This day is essential for enhancing your chances of a successful summit attempt by allowing your body to acclimatize properly.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
text: Today’s trek takes you across the expansive lunar desert known as the Saddle, a rugged and barren landscape stretching between the Kibo and Mawenzi peaks. Although the terrain may seem stark and desolate, the awe-inspiring views of the towering peaks on either side are a highlight of this journey. The hike typically takes around 6 hours, allowing plenty of time to soak in the vastness of the landscape and appreciate the unique beauty of this high-altitude environment.

Upon reaching Kibo Hut, you’ll settle in for an early dinner and some much-needed rest, conserving your energy for the upcoming summit attempt. In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing to prepare you for the final ascent, which will begin just before midnight. This briefing is essential, as it covers the route, safety measures, and what to expect during the challenging climb ahead. Proper preparation and rest are crucial for a successful summit bid.

days.label: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut

stats.Altitude: : 4,700 meters (15,419 feet) – 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)

text: Around midnight, you’ll be awakened to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. The journey to Gillman’s Point at 5,685 meters is steep and strenuous, typically taking around six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will test your endurance, but your guide will offer support and encouragement along the way.

Once you reach Gillman’s Point, you’ll traverse the crater rim toward Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If the weather cooperates, you’ll be rewarded with a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, a truly unforgettable sight. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll descend back to Kibo Hut for a short rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night, allowing your body to recover after the exhilarating challenge.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
text: After breakfast, you’ll start your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll be presented with your well-earned summit certificate as a testament to your achievement.

From there, you’ll be driven back to your Hotel in Moshi, where a hot meal, a refreshing shower, and a comfortable bed await you. If you’re interested in extending your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator to explore options like a thrilling wildlife safari or a relaxing trip to the stunning beaches of Zanzibar. This is the perfect way to celebrate your successful climb and enjoy more of what Tanzania has to offer!

If you wish to extend your adventure, you can add a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, feel free to visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or delving into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion. If you’re interested in adding a safari experience, please visit our Safari page for more information on our exciting safari options. This will ensure your Tanzanian adventure is truly unforgettable!

title: Northern circuit route · 9 days
metaDescription: Embark on a unique adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Northern Circuit Route, starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport and a smooth transfer to your Hotel for your overnight stay. Here, you’ll enjoy a delicious
overview: Embark on a unique adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Northern Circuit Route, starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport and a smooth transfer to your Hotel for your overnight stay. Here, you’ll enjoy a delicious dinner and breakfast, setting the stage for your trek.

The journey begins with a drive to Lemosho Gate, where you’ll register before hiking through lush forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Camp. Over the coming days, you’ll explore diverse landscapes, including moorlands, alpine deserts, and ridges, with notable stops at Moir Hut, Pofu Camp, and Third Caves Camp.

The trek culminates in a challenging summit attempt to Uhuru Peak. After reaching the summit, you’ll descend to Millennium Camp and Mweka Gate, concluding with a return to your Hotel for a well-deserved rest. Optional extensions include safaris and visits to Zanzibar, providing an opportunity to create unforgettable memories in Tanzania.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be eagerly waiting for you, holding a sign with your name on it to extend a warm welcome. From there, you’ll enjoy a seamless transfer to your Hotel.

Upon arrival, a delicious meal will be served to help you recharge after your journey. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This session is an exciting opportunity to learn about the wonders that await you on your expedition.

During your stay at your Hotel, take advantage of the relaxing environment, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This is the perfect way to unwind before your adventure begins!

days.label: Moshi to Lemosho Park Gate to Mti Mkubwa Camp
text: After breakfast and a briefing from your guide at your Hotel, you’ll set off on a 1.5-hour drive to Lemosho Park Gate (2,100m).

Upon arrival at Londorossi Gate, you’ll complete the necessary registration. The trek begins along scenic forest trails, leading you to Mti Mkubwa Campsite (2,750m), which is approximately a 3-hour hike.Upon reaching Mti Mkubwa, the porters will set up your tents, and our chef will prepare a delicious lunch for you to enjoy.

After your meal, take some time to relax and acclimate to the surroundings. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventure ahead.

days.label: Mti Mkubwa Camp to Shira Camp 2
text: Start your day with an early breakfast before embarking on your trek from Mti Mkubwa Camp. The trail will take you through diverse landscapes, including moorlands, with stunning views of Kibo Volcano.

You can expect to hike for approximately 5 hours, arriving at Shira Camp 1, where you’ll enjoy a hot lunch prepared by our chef.After your meal, you’ll continue your trek to Shira Camp 2, which is about 2–3 hours away. Located at a higher altitude, Shira Camp 2 offers expansive views of the surrounding landscapes.

Upon arrival, our porters will set up your tents, and you’ll have time to relax and acclimate before dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the following day’s trek, ensuring you are prepared for the adventures ahead.

days.label: Shira 2 Camp | Moir Hut
text: Begin your trek with an early breakfast at Shira Camp 2, then set out toward Moir Hut. As you start, the trail gradually steepens, leading you into the giant heather moorland zone while crossing Shira Ridge.

This route offers breathtaking views of the surrounding landscapes, enriching your trekking experience.By early afternoon, you’ll arrive at Moir Hut (4,200 m), where you can take some time to relax and acclimate.

This section of the trek features gentle ascents paired with spectacular vistas, helping prepare you for the more challenging days ahead. The peaceful environment at Moir Hut allows you to recharge and gather your energy for the journey to come.

days.label: Moir Hut | Pofu Camp
text: Start your trek with breakfast at Moir Hut, then proceed out of the moorland and into the alpine desert. Ascend a steep ridge off the main trail, a climb that will take about 5 to 7 hours to reach Pofu Camp (4,025 m).

As you trek, enjoy the magnificent views of Kenya’s wild lands to the north.This challenging section of the journey offers a dramatic contrast to the lush moorland previously experienced, highlighting the stark beauty and vast expanse of the alpine desert.
Arriving at Pofu Camp, you’ll have the opportunity to take in these breathtaking landscapes and prepare for the next stages of your adventure.

days.label: Pofu Camp | Third Caves Camp
text: Begin your trek from Pofu Camp with a hearty breakfast, then continue eastward through valleys and ridges in the alpine desert and moorland.

This trek, which takes approximately 5 to 7 hours, rewards you with expansive views of the vast mountain wilderness. As you progress, the rugged terrain and panoramic vistas provide a dramatic backdrop to your journey.

Upon arrival at Third Caves Camp (3,600 m), you’ll have ample time to rest and acclimate, soaking in the serene surroundings. Enjoy the tranquil atmosphere as you prepare for the next day’s adventure, and savor a well-deserved dinner amidst the stunning landscapes.

days.label: Third Caves Camp to Mawenzi Tarn Camp
text: Trek steadily upward to Mawenzi Tarn Camp, situated at an altitude of 4,315 meters, nestled at the base of the steep and dramatic ridges of Mawenzi, Kilimanjaro’s second highest peak.

This segment of the trek takes you through rugged terrain, and as you climb, the landscape becomes increasingly majestic.Upon arrival at Mawenzi Tarn Camp, you’ll be greeted by breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and the tranquil tarn that adds to the camp’s serene atmosphere.

The peaceful setting provides a perfect backdrop for relaxation and acclimatization, allowing you to fully appreciate the grandeur of your surroundings and prepare for the next leg of your journey. Enjoy a well-deserved dinner while taking in the stunning scenery and discussing plans for the following day with your guide.

days.label: Mawenzi Tarn Hut to Kibo Hut
text: After breakfast, you’ll embark on a trek across the vast, barren lunar landscape known as the “Saddle,” which stretches between Mawenzi and Kibo peaks.

This unique terrain, while desolate, is mesmerizing, featuring rugged vistas with the summit of Kilimanjaro looming in the distance. The trail, though long, maintains a gentle incline, allowing for a steady pace as you approach this final stage of your journey.Upon arriving at Kibo Hut, you’ll have the opportunity to rest and enjoy an early dinner, conserving energy for the summit attempt later that night.

Your guide will provide a detailed briefing to prepare you for the ascent to Uhuru Peak, which begins shortly after midnight. This final climb will challenge your endurance and determination, but reaching the summit will be a rewarding experience that you’ll cherish forever

days.label: Kibo Camp | Uhuru Peak | Millennium Camp
text: Wake up around midnight to start your summit trek. Begin hiking at 1 AM, navigating switchbacks and loose rock as you ascend to Gillman’s Point (5,685 m). This initial section will test your endurance and determination as you face the steep challenges ahead.

From Gillman’s Point, continue the final stretch to Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), the highest point in Africa. Here, you can enjoy breathtaking views and capture unforgettable moments at the summit.After taking in the magnificent scenery, begin your descent to Millennium Camp (3,110 m) to rest for the night.

The challenging climb to the summit, followed by the descent, will be both physically demanding and rewarding, making the evening’s rest at Millennium Camp a well-deserved reprieve. Enjoy the sense of accomplishment as you reflect on your incredible journey on Kilimanjaro.

days.label: Millennium Camp | Mweka Gate
text: Descend from Millennium Camp (3,110 m) to Mweka Gate (1,830 m) in approximately 2 to 3 hours. Once at the gate, you’ll receive your climbing certificate to commemorate your achievement.
Afterward, you’ll be transferred back to the Hotel for your overnight stay. Enjoy a relaxing evening at the hotel, reflecting on your incredible journey and the accomplishment of your climb.

If you have booked a safari, our safari coordinator will meet with you in the afternoon to provide a pre-briefing and discuss your upcoming adventure. For more details about the safari options, please visit our Safari page.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you wish to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, we invite you to visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re looking for relaxation on pristine beaches or eager to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.
If you’re interested in adding a safari experience, please visit our Safari page for more information on our exciting safari options.

title: Rongai Route · 6 days
metaDescription: The 6-day Rongai Route offers a unique and scenic path to the summit of Kilimanjaro, starting on the northern side of the mountain near the Kenyan border. This less-traveled route allows you to enjoy the breathtaking wilderness without the
overview: The 6-day Rongai Route offers a unique and scenic path to the summit of Kilimanjaro, starting on the northern side of the mountain near the Kenyan border. This less-traveled route allows you to enjoy the breathtaking wilderness without the crowds, providing an intimate trekking experience.

Your journey begins with your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where you will be welcomed by our driver and taken to the Hotel for a relaxing night. Here, you’ll also participate in a pre-trek briefing with your guides.

The trek starts at the remote Rongai Gate, where you will traverse various ecosystems, from lush rainforests to alpine deserts, culminating in the glaciers at Uhuru Peak. Along the way, you’ll acclimatize at designated camps, with our expert guides ensuring your safety and comfort throughout the ascent.

After reaching the summit of Uhuru Peak, you will descend via the Marangu Route, allowing you to experience different aspects of the mountain. Once the trek is complete, you’ll return to the Hotel for a well-deserved rest. For those wishing to extend their adventure, options for a safari or a Zanzibar beach vacation are available, creating a full Tanzanian experience.

Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you an exciting opportunity to learn about the wonders that await in your upcoming expedition.
Take some time to unwind in the relaxing environment of your Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, perfect for your first night in Tanzania.

days.label: Moshi to Rongai Gate | Simba Camp
text: After a hearty breakfast at the hotel, you’ll embark on a scenic 2 to 3-hour drive to the Rongai Gate, passing through picturesque farmlands and rural villages. Upon arrival at the gate, you’ll complete the registration process before commencing your trek through lush farmlands and pine forests.

The trail begins with a gentle ascent, allowing you to gradually acclimatize to the altitude. Along the way, keep an eye out for wildlife, including the playful colobus monkeys. The serene surroundings provide a great introduction to Kilimanjaro’s diverse landscapes.
Once you arrive at Simba Camp, you’ll be treated to a hot meal and settle in for the night, resting up for the adventures that lie ahead.

days.label: Trek to Kikelewa Camp
text: After an early breakfast, you’ll embark on your trek, ascending through the picturesque moorland zone. As you climb higher, the landscape opens up, revealing stunning views of the eastern ice fields along Kilimanjaro’s crater rim. The trail becomes steeper as you approach Kikelewa Camp, where you’ll be rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding areas.

Upon arrival at the camp, you can enjoy a hot, freshly prepared meal and take some time to rest. Soaking in the serenity of the high-altitude environment will help you prepare for the next stage of your adventure, ensuring you are well-rested and ready for the challenges ahead.

days.label: Trek to Mawenzi Tarn
text: Today’s trek is shorter but steeper, leading you through grassy slopes that culminate at the stunning Mawenzi Tarn, nestled beneath the towering cliffs of Mawenzi Peak. The campsite is set in a dramatic and picturesque landscape, offering breathtaking views in every direction.

Upon arrival, you’ll enjoy a hot lunch and have some time to relax. You can also take a short acclimatization hike to help your body adjust to the altitude. In the evening, a delicious dinner will be served, followed by an informative briefing from your guide, preparing you for the next day’s trek to higher altitudes. This day is crucial for acclimatization, ensuring you are well-prepared for the challenges ahead.

Your guide will provide a detailed briefing in the evening, as the ascent to Uhuru Peak will begin shortly after midnight, ensuring you’re fully prepared for this exhilarating challenge.

text: After enjoying breakfast at the hotel, you’ll embark on a scenic 2 to 3-hour drive to the Rongai Gate, where you’ll be surrounded by picturesque farmlands and rural villages. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll complete the registration process before commencing your trek through lush farmlands and serene pine forests.

The trail begins with a gentle ascent, which allows you to gradually acclimatize to the altitude. Keep an eye out for wildlife, including the playful colobus monkeys that may cross your path. The peaceful surroundings serve as a wonderful introduction to the diverse landscapes of Kilimanjaro.
Once you arrive at Simba Camp, you’ll be welcomed with a hot meal, providing nourishment and comfort as you settle in for the night, preparing for the adventures that lie ahead.

days.label: Trek to Kikelewa Camp
text: Begin your day with a steady ascent to the Second Cave, where you’ll stop for a delicious lunch. Afterward, continue your journey across the moorland, following a smaller path that leads you closer to the jagged peaks of Mawenzi. This section of the trek is particularly beautiful, offering stunning views and a profound sense of isolation as you navigate the unique terrain.

After approximately 10 kilometers, you’ll arrive at Kikelewa Camp, nestled in a sheltered valley adorned with towering giant Senecios and near the Kikelewa Cave. This camp serves as an ideal resting spot, allowing you to acclimatize to the altitude while soaking in the breathtaking scenery. Take this opportunity to relax, enjoy your surroundings, and prepare mentally and physically for the challenges that await in the coming days.

days.label: Trek to Mawenzi Tarn
text: Today’s trek is shorter but steeper, leading you through grassy slopes toward the stunning Mawenzi Tarn, which is nestled beneath the towering cliffs of Mawenzi Peak. The campsite is set in a dramatic and picturesque landscape, offering breathtaking views in every direction.

Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted with a hot lunch, providing a refreshing break after your ascent. You’ll have the opportunity to relax and soak in the serene surroundings or take a short acclimatization hike to help your body adjust to the altitude. This is crucial for preparing for the higher elevations you’ll encounter in the upcoming days.

In the evening, you’ll enjoy a delicious dinner, followed by an informative briefing from your guide. This briefing will prepare you for the next day’s trek to higher altitudes, ensuring you’re equipped with the knowledge and confidence needed for the challenges ahead.

days.label: Acclimatization Day at Mawenzi Tarn
text: This extra day at Mawenzi Tarn is crucial for acclimatization. Take the opportunity to hike toward Mawenzi Peak, which not only helps your body adjust to the higher altitude but also offers splendid views of the surrounding landscape. The hike is designed to acclimatize you to the thinner air, preparing you for the more demanding stages of your trek.

After your hike, return to Mawenzi Tarn to rest and relax. This rest day is vital for building the stamina needed for the challenging trek ahead to Kibo Hut. During this time, it’s essential to stay well-hydrated and focused, as proper preparation is key for your upcoming summit attempt. Embrace this day as a chance to enjoy the stunning scenery while ensuring your body is ready for the final push.

days.label: Mawenzi Tarn Hut to Kibo Hut
text: After breakfast, you’ll embark on a trek across the vast, barren lunar landscape known as the “Saddle,” which stretches between Mawenzi and Kibo peaks. The terrain here is desolate yet mesmerizing, featuring rugged vistas with the summit looming ahead in the distance. Although the trail is long, it maintains a gentle incline, allowing for a steady pace as you approach the final stage of your journey.

Upon arriving at Kibo Hut, you’ll have the opportunity to rest and enjoy an early dinner to conserve energy for the summit attempt. Your guide will provide a detailed briefing about the ascent to Uhuru Peak, which begins shortly after midnight. This preparation is crucial as you gear up for the final push toward Africa’s highest point.

days.label: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut

stats.Altitude: 4,700 meters (15,419 feet) – 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)

text: Around midnight, you’ll be awakened to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. This journey to Gillman’s Point, at 5,685 meters, is steep and strenuous, typically taking about six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will test your endurance, but your guide will be there to offer support along the way.

Upon reaching Gillman’s Point, you’ll traverse the crater rim toward Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If the weather cooperates, you’ll be rewarded with a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, an experience that many climbers describe as life-changing. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll descend to Kibo Hut for a short rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night, where you can reflect on your remarkable journey.
This day will be one of the most challenging yet rewarding parts of your trek, so make sure you stay hydrated and pace yourself throughout the ascent!

days.label: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
text: After breakfast, you’ll start your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. As you trek downward, take in the final views of the landscape and reflect on your incredible accomplishment. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll receive your well-earned summit certificate as a testament to your achievement.

Following this, you’ll be driven back to the Hotel in Moshi, where a hot meal, refreshing shower, and comfortable bed await you. If you’re interested in extending your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator to explore options such as a thrilling wildlife safari or a relaxing trip to the stunning beaches of Zanzibar. This is the perfect opportunity to celebrate your trek and discover more of Tanzania’s beauty!

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you wish to extend your adventure, you may consider adding a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, we invite you to visit our Day Trip page. Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or delving into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar offers something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.

If you’re interested in adding a safari experience to your journey, please visit our Safari page for more information on our exciting safari options. This is a wonderful opportunity to create unforgettable memories in Tanzania!

title: Umbwe Route · 6 days
metaDescription: This trek offers an adventurous ascent up Mount Kilimanjaro via the challenging Umbwe Route, known for its steep and direct approach. Starting from the southern side of the mountain, this route provides a dramatic and less-traveled path to
overview: This trek offers an adventurous ascent up Mount Kilimanjaro via the challenging Umbwe Route, known for its steep and direct approach. Starting from the southern side of the mountain, this route provides a dramatic and less-traveled path to the summit. Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be welcomed by our driver and transferred to the Hotel for a comfortable night, including a pre-trek briefing with your guides.

The trek begins at the Umbwe Gate, where you will traverse through dense forests and ascend through rugged terrain, eventually reaching the high-altitude zones. You will acclimate at various camps, ensuring a safe and steady ascent. After reaching Uhuru Peak, you’ll descend through lush rainforests to the Mweka Gate. Completing the trek, you will return to the Hotel for rest and reflection. For those looking to extend their adventure, options for a safari or a beach vacation in Zanzibar are available.
This overview captures the essence of the Umbwe Route, emphasizing its unique challenges and the stunning natural beauty that awaits trekkers.

days.label: Arrival
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be eagerly anticipating your arrival, holding a sign with your name for a warm welcome. You’ll enjoy a seamless transfer to the Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you.

Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will provide a pre-trekking briefing, offering insights into the wonders that await during your expedition. Take advantage of the relaxing environment at Hotel, which features a swimming pool, beautiful gardens, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring a comfortable start to your adventure.

days.label: Umbwe Gate to Umbwe Camp
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to the Umbwe Gate to begin your trek. The path through the dense rainforest is steep and demanding, providing a true wilderness experience. As you gradually ascend, you’ll witness the rich vegetation and unique atmosphere of the rainforest, filled with vibrant flora and the sounds of nature.

Upon reaching Umbwe Camp, you can enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, giving you the energy needed for the days ahead. This initial section of the trek, while challenging, sets the stage for the adventures to come. Settle in for the night at the camp, nestled in the lush forest, where you can relax and rejuvenate for the next day’s journey.

days.label: Umbwe Camp to Barranco Camp
text: After enjoying breakfast at Machame Camp, you’ll set off towards Shira Camp, covering about 5 kilometers in a journey that typically takes 4 to 5 hours.

The trail begins with a steep ascent through the scenic moorland zone, where you’ll be treated to breathtaking views as you climb. As you near Shira Camp, you’ll walk along a ridge offering spectacular vistas of the surrounding landscape. Upon arrival, the porters will set up your tents and prepare lunch. You’ll have the afternoon to relax and acclimate to the altitude before dinner, followed by a briefing from your guide on the next day’s trek.

days.label: Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. The journey may involve ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that offers stunning views once conquered. After navigating the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic Karanga Valley, renowned for its lush vegetation and breathtaking landscapes.

Upon reaching the Karanga campsite, the porters will set up tents while our chef prepares lunch. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to camp. In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by the chef. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details.

days.label: Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu Camp. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, offering breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, focus on acclimatization to avoid altitude-related issues.

Upon reaching Barafu Camp, our porters will handle camp setup while the chef prepares lunch. After eating, take the opportunity to rest until dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt, covering the route, challenges, safety measures, and preparations. Be sure to rest well, as the summit ascent begins late in the evening.

days.label: Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak and Mweka Camp
text: You’ll rise around 11:30 PM and start the ascent after having some tea and biscuits. Heading northwest, you’ll climb through scree towards Stella Point on the crater rim. The trek to Stella Point (5,685 m) takes about 6 hours and is often the most mentally and physically challenging part of the climb.

After a brief rest at Stella Point, you’ll be rewarded with a magnificent sunrise, weather permitting. From there, it’s a 2-hour ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point on Mount Kilimanjaro. Your time at the summit will depend on the weather, so don’t linger too long due to the cold and fatigue.

The descent to Barafu Camp takes about 3 hours for a short rest before continuing to Mweka Camp, where you’ll enjoy dinner and overnight accommodations. This day is both challenging and rewarding, offering stunning views and a sense of accomplishment at reaching the summit.

days.label: Mweka Camp to Moshi
text: After breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where you’ll complete the final leg of your trek. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll be driven back to your Hotel, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you.

At the end of the trip, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose are available at the hotel. If you wish to extend your adventure with a safari, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, the coordinator will provide a briefing on the various safari options available. We highly recommend booking a safari with us to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty, making your journey truly unforgettable.

days.label: Departure Day | Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in the local culture. For more details, visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you might want to continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar offers something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.
If you’re interested in adding a safari experience, please visit our Safari page for more information on our exciting safari options.
