title: Climbing Mount Meru · 3 days
metaDescription: Begin your Mount Meru trekking adventure with a warm welcome at your hotel in Moshi. After a detailed briefing from our experienced guides, you’ll drive to the
overview: Begin your Mount Meru trekking adventure with a warm welcome at your hotel in Moshi. After a detailed briefing from our experienced guides, you’ll drive to the Momela Gate, the entry point to Arusha National Park. Over the next four days, you’ll hike through the stunning landscapes of Mount Meru, accompanied by armed ranger escorts for added security. Keep an eye out for wildlife such as buffalo, zebras, giraffes, and antelope as you explore.

As you progress, you’ll traverse lush montane forests, ascend scenic ridges, and enjoy spectacular views of the Ash Cone and Meru Crater. The highlight of your trek will be the summit climb to Socialist Peak, where you’ll be rewarded with breathtaking sunrise views and a panorama that includes Mount Kilimanjaro.

After completing the trek, you’ll be transferred back to your hotel for a well-deserved rest. If you wish to extend your adventure in Tanzania, optional extensions to Kilimanjaro climbing, a trip to Zanzibar, or safari experiences are available.

days.label: Arrival and Welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly welcome you, holding a sign with your name for easy identification. You will then enjoy a seamless transfer to the charming Sal salinero Hotel, where you’ll be greeted with a delicious meal to refuel after your travels.

Later in the day, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will provide a pre-trekking briefing, giving you an exciting opportunity to learn about the wonders that await you on your upcoming expedition. Take some time to relax and enjoy the tranquil environment of Sal salinero Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This welcoming atmosphere is the perfect way to kick off your adventure in Tanzania!

days.label: Arusha to Momela Gate to Meriakamba Hut
text: Cycling Distance: 10 km
Cycling Time: 4-6 hours

Begin your adventure with a scenic drive from Moshi to Momela Gate, where you’ll complete the necessary registration and meet your trekking team. From this point, your journey commences with an armed ranger escort, ensuring your safety as you hike through the stunning Montane Forest.

As you trek, keep an eye out for the diverse wildlife that calls this area home, including elephants, giraffes, zebras, and various species of monkeys. The path to Meriakamba Hut is moderately challenging, allowing you to acclimatize to the altitude while enjoying the beautiful natural surroundings. This trek sets the stage for the breathtaking experiences that await you on Mount Meru.

days.label: Meriakamba Hut to Saddle Hut
text: Cycling Distance: 8 km
Cycling Time: 3-5 hours

After an early breakfast, you’ll begin your trek toward Saddle Hut, taking on a steep ascent that promises incredible rewards. As you climb higher, you’ll be treated to stunning views of the Meru Crater and the majestic Ash Cone, making every effort worthwhile. Upon reaching Saddle Hut, a hot lunch will be prepared for you, allowing you to refuel and relax after the challenging hike.

Once you’ve had a chance to rest, you can opt for a short hike to the summit of Little Meru. This excursion offers breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding landscape, providing the perfect way to conclude your day. The combination of the day’s strenuous trek and the reward of stunning vistas truly enhances the adventure of climbing Mount Meru.

days.label: Saddle Hut to Summit to Return to Momela Gate
text: Cycling Distance: 5 km up, 13 km down
Cycling Time: 12-14 hours

Summit Day begins in the early hours with a challenging ascent from Saddle Hut to Rhino Point, followed by a steep climb to Socialist Peak, the highest point of Mount Meru. You’ll reach the summit just as the sun rises, offering breathtaking panoramic views, including the iconic sight of Kilimanjaro rising majestically above the clouds. This moment is not only a highlight of the trek but also an incredible opportunity for photos and reflection.

After taking in the stunning scenery and enjoying a brief rest at the summit, you’ll begin your descent back to Saddle Hut for a well-deserved brunch. Following your meal, continue the descent through the scenic landscape back to Momela Gate, where a transfer will be waiting to take you back to your hotel in Moshi, concluding an unforgettable climbing experience.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider climbing Kilimanjaro or adding a day trip to explore nearby attractions and immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, please visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion. If you’re interested in adding a safari experience, visit our Safari page for exciting options that showcase Tanzania’s incredible wildlife and landscapes.

title: Climbing Mount Meru · 4 days
metaDescription: Begin your Mount Meru trekking adventure with a warm welcome at your hotel in Arusha. After a detailed briefing by our experienced guides, your journey starts with a drive to the Momela Gate, the entry point to Arusha National Park. Over th
overview: Begin your Mount Meru trekking adventure with a warm welcome at your hotel in Arusha. After a detailed briefing by our experienced guides, your journey starts with a drive to the Momela Gate, the entry point to Arusha National Park. Over the next four days, you’ll hike through the stunning landscapes of Meru, accompanied by armed ranger escorts for added security. This trek offers opportunities to spot wildlife such as buffalo, zebras, giraffes, and various antelope along the way.

As you progress, you’ll traverse the lush Montane Forest, ascend scenic ridges, and enjoy spectacular views of the Ash Cone and Meru Crater. The summit climb to Socialist Peak rewards you with a breathtaking sunrise and stunning views of Kilimanjaro.

After completing the trek, you’ll be transferred back to your hotel for a well-deserved rest. If you wish to extend your adventure in Tanzania, optional extensions to Kilimanjaro climbing, Zanzibar, or safaris are available.

days.label: Arrival
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name. You’ll receive a warm welcome as you begin your adventure. From the airport, you’ll be transferred comfortably to Sal salinero hotel , a charming establishment known for its inviting atmosphere.

After checking in, enjoy a delicious meal at the hotel. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will provide a pre-trekking briefing, preparing you for the incredible journey ahead. Take some time to unwind and enjoy the hotel’s amenities, including a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, and a bar and restaurant, ensuring a relaxing start to your expedition.

days.label: Arusha to Momela Gate to Meriakamba Hut
text: Cycling Distance: 10 km
Cycling Time: 4-6 hours

After enjoying breakfast, you’ll be transferred from Moshi to Arusha National Park, where you’ll check in with park personnel before embarking on your trek from Momella Gate. The journey begins in the late morning, taking you through open grasslands that are home to buffalo, warthogs, and giraffes, providing excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing.

As you progress, the trail features a steady climb into the lush montane forest. You’ll pause for lunch near the famous Fig Tree, then continue through less dense areas, where you can spot a variety of birds and monkeys, including the striking black-and-white Colobus. By mid-afternoon, you’ll be rewarded with stunning views of Meru’s towering cliffs and the Ash Cone. Arriving at Miriakamba Huts, nestled in a serene grassy glade, you’ll have a perfect spot to relax and take in the breathtaking surroundings. Keep an eye out—you might even spot a giraffe wandering through camp!

days.label: Meriakamba Hut to Saddle Hut
text: Cycling Distance: 8 km
Cycling Time: 3-5 hours

Get an early start to catch a glimpse of Kilimanjaro before the clouds gather. Your trek begins with a steep ascent from Miriakamba Hut to the crater rim, known as Elephant Ridge. The trail weaves through lush montane forest, providing breathtaking views as you climb. You will eventually reach the giant heather and moorland situated between Little Meru and Meru.

Upon arriving at Saddle Hut, you can enjoy a hot lunch to refuel. The afternoon offers time to rest, or you may opt for an optional hike to the summit of Little Meru (3,820 m / 12,533 ft). This hike rewards you with stunning views of the surrounding landscapes, especially as the sun sets, casting a golden hue over the peaks and valleys. The ascent provides a fantastic opportunity to acclimatize and prepare for the summit climb the next day.

days.label: Summit Day (Socialist Peak) to Saddle Hut to Miriakamba Hut
text: Cycling Distance: 5 km up, 13 km down
Cycling Time: 12-14 hours time

Your summit day begins early at 2 AM, kicking off with a steep climb to Rhino Point (3,800 m / 12,467 ft). Depending on the weather, you may pause here to witness a spectacular sunrise. If conditions permit, you will continue along a rugged ridge, reaching Cobra Point (4,350 m / 14,271 ft) just as the sun begins to rise.

The views from Cobra Point are stunning, featuring the crater rim cliffs, the Ash Cone, and Kilimanjaro towering above the clouds, along with expansive vistas of the Rift Valley.After a further hour of climbing, you’ll reach the summit of Mount Meru.

The hike back to Rhino Point in the morning light is equally breathtaking, offering a chance to soak in the beauty of the surrounding landscapes. Once back at Saddle Hut, you’ll enjoy a well-deserved brunch and take some time to rest before continuing your descent to Miriakamba Hut for the night (if you’re on a 4-day itinerary). This day will be memorable, filled with incredible views and a strong sense of achievement as you conquer one of Tanzania’s stunning peaks.

days.label: Miriakamba Hut to Momella Gate to Moshi
text: Cycling Distance: 10 km
Cycling Time: 3-5 hours time

On your final day, you’ll take a different, faster route down through open grasslands and mixed forests, providing excellent wildlife viewing opportunities along the way. Keep your eyes peeled for various animals as you enjoy stunning views of the crater and the expansive plains of Arusha National Park.

By late morning, you’ll arrive at Momella Gate, where you’ll have the chance to bid farewell to your dedicated guides and porters who accompanied you on this incredible journey. Following this heartfelt farewell, a vehicle will be waiting to transfer you back to Sal salinero hotel or a similar hotel in Moshi for a well-deserved celebration of your trekking adventure.
This marks the end of an unforgettable experience on Mount Meru, where you’ve conquered challenges and created lasting memories.

text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider climbing Kilimanjaro or adding a day trip to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, we invite you to visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or delving into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.

title: Lemosho Route Group Departure · 7 days · Group
metaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a transfer to your hotel, where you’ll receive a briefing from our ex
overview: Embark on an unforgettable adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a transfer to your hotel, where you’ll receive a briefing from our experienced guides. Enjoy the hotel’s amenities, including a pool, garden, bar, and restaurant, for a comfortable start.

The trek starts with a drive to Lemosho Park Gate and a hike through lush forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Camp. Over the next few days, you’ll ascend through stunning landscapes, including Shira 1 and Shira 2 camps, Lava Tower, and the Barranco Wall. Each day presents new challenges and incredible views, culminating in the summit attempt to Uhuru Peak.

After reaching the summit, you’ll descend to Mweka Camp and return to your hotel for a hot meal and to reflect on your achievement. Optional extensions include safaris or Zanzibar visits, allowing further exploration of Tanzania’s beauty.
This journey combines adventure with the opportunity to experience Tanzania’s breathtaking landscapes and culture, ensuring an unforgettable trip.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name for a warm welcome. From there, you will enjoy a seamless and comfortable transfer to your Hotel.

Upon arrival, you’ll be served a delicious meal to replenish your energy. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will provide a pre-trekking briefing, offering valuable insights into the wonders that await you on your expedition.
Take the time to relax in the inviting atmosphere of your Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring a pleasant start to your adventure.

days.label: Moshi - Lemosho Park Gate - Mti Mkubwa Camp
text: On your first day, after enjoying breakfast and attending a briefing with your guide at your Hotel, you’ll be transferred to Lemosho Park Gate (2,100m), a scenic 1.5-hour drive. At Londorossi Gate, you’ll complete the necessary registration before embarking on your trek.

The hike along picturesque forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Campsite (2,750m) typically takes around 3 hours. Upon your arrival, the porters will set up your tents, and our chef will prepare a hearty lunch for you to enjoy. After your meal, you’ll have some free time to relax and acclimatize before dinner.
In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you are well-prepared for the adventure ahead.

days.label: Mti Mkubwa Camp | Shira Camp 2
text: Begin your day with an early breakfast before setting out on your trek from Mti Mkubwa Camp. The trail will lead you through diverse landscapes, including lush moorlands and stunning views of Kibo Volcano. You’ll hike for approximately 5 hours, reaching Shira Camp 1, where a hot lunch prepared by our chef awaits you.

After your meal, continue the trek to Shira Camp 2, which is about 2-3 hours away. This campsite is located at a higher altitude, providing expansive views of the surrounding landscapes. Upon arrival, our porters will set up your tents, and you’ll have time to relax and acclimatize before dinner.
In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing on the following day’s trek, ensuring you are well-prepared for the adventure ahead.

days.label: Shira Camp 2 | Barranco Camp
text: Start the day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route includes a climb to the Lava Tower at 4,630 meters, passing through a semi-desert, rocky landscape.

After approximately 5 hours of hiking, enjoy a well-deserved lunch before ascending the rocky scree path to the Lava Tower. This demanding day might test your endurance as you adjust to the higher altitude. After lunch, you’ll descend 680 meters to the Barranco Camp, where the true benefit of acclimatization becomes clear.

The 2-hour descent offers stunning photo opportunities of the Western Breach, a notable feature of Kilimanjaro’s landscape. End the day with a memorable sunset and a delicious dinner at Barranco Camp, where you can relax and reflect on the day’s adventures before preparing for the next leg of your journey.

days.label: Barranco Camp | Karanga Camp
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s adventure involves ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that offers stunning views of the surrounding landscapes. Once you conquer the Wall, you’ll descend into the picturesque Karanga Valley, known for its lush vegetation and breathtaking scenery. Upon reaching the Karanga Camp, our dedicated porters will set up the tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch for you.
After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to Karanga Camp. This hike is crucial for your body’s adjustment to the altitude.

In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, and after dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and essential details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the upcoming adventure.

days.label: Karanga Camp | Barafu Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu Camp. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, providing breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s essential to focus on acclimatization to avoid altitude-related issues. Upon reaching Barafu Camp, our porters will efficiently handle the camp setup while the chef prepares a delicious lunch for you.

After enjoying your meal, take some time to rest and recharge until dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt, covering critical aspects such as the route, challenges, safety measures, and preparations to ensure you are ready for this significant part of your journey. Try to rest well tonight, as the summit ascent begins late in the evening, requiring your full energy and focus.

days.label: Summit Day | Barafu Camp | Uhuru Peak
text: You’ll rise around 11:30 PM and start your ascent after a light meal of tea and biscuits. Heading northwest, you’ll climb through scree towards Stella Point on the crater rim. This challenging 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5,685m) is often the most mentally and physically demanding part of the climb.

After a brief rest at Stella Point, if weather conditions allow, you’ll be treated to a stunning sunrise. From Stella Point, it’s a 2-hour snow-covered ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point on Kilimanjaro.

Your time at the summit will depend on the weather, so it’s important not to linger too long due to the cold and fatigue. The descent to Barafu Camp takes approximately 3 hours, where you can take a short rest before continuing on to Mweka Camp for dinner and an overnight stay, reflecting on your incredible achievement.

days.label: Mweka Camp | Moshi
text: After breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where your adventure concludes. A comfortable drive will take you back to Moshi, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you, providing a well-deserved opportunity to relax.

At the end of your trip, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel. If you wish to extend your adventure with a safari, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, the coordinator will provide a briefing on various safari options available.
We highly recommend booking a safari with us to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty, making your journey truly unforgettable.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you will be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in the local culture. For more information, you can check our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you might want to continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Discover the perfect package for your next excursion by exploring our Zanzibar page.
If you’re also interested in adding a safari experience, please visit our Safari page for more details about our exciting safari options.

title: Lemosho Route Group Departure · 8 days · Group
metaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable group adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your hotel, where you’ll meet fellow climb
overview: Embark on an unforgettable group adventure climbing Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho Route. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your hotel, where you’ll meet fellow climbers. Here, our experienced guides will provide a detailed briefing, setting the stage for your trek. Enjoy the hotel’s amenities, including a pool, garden, bar, and restaurant, ensuring a relaxing and comfortable start to your adventure.

The trek kicks off with a group transfer to Lemosho Park Gate for registration, followed by a hike through lush forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Camp. Over the next few days, you and your group will ascend through spectacular landscapes, including Shira 1 and Shira 2 camps, the Lava Tower, and the iconic Barranco Wall. Each day brings new challenges and stunning scenery, fostering camaraderie among group members as you work toward your shared goal of reaching Uhuru Peak.

After celebrating your summit success, you will descend to Mweka Camp before returning to the hotel for a hot meal and well-deserved rest. Reflect on your achievement with your group and share stories of the climb. Optional post-trek extensions include safaris and trips to Zanzibar, offering additional opportunities to explore Tanzania’s natural and cultural beauty.
This group departure itinerary is designed to deliver an enriching experience, combining teamwork, adventure, and comfort, while showcasing the best of Tanzania’s wonders.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be waiting to greet you with a sign displaying your name, offering a warm welcome. Following this, you’ll enjoy a seamless transfer to the charming Hotel, where you can relax and unwind. Upon your arrival, a delicious meal will be served to you.

Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This informative session is an exciting opportunity for you to learn about the adventure that lies ahead and the various wonders you will encounter during your expedition.
The Hotel provides a relaxing atmosphere, complete with a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring a comfortable start to your Kilimanjaro adventure.

days.label: Lemosho Route
text: On your first day, you’ll begin with breakfast and a briefing from your guide at your Hotel. Following this, you’ll embark on a 1.5-hour drive to Lemosho Park Gate (2,100m). Once you arrive at Lemosho Gate, you’ll complete the necessary registration before starting your trek.

Your adventure begins with a hike along scenic forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Campsite (2,750m). This trek typically takes around 3 hours. Upon reaching the campsite, the porters will set up your tents, and our chef will prepare a delicious lunch for you.

After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some time to relax and acclimate to your surroundings. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventures that lie ahead.
This day sets the tone for your expedition, combining travel, nature, and preparation for the exciting days to come.

days.label: MTI MKUBWA CAMP | SHIRA CAMP 1
text: On the second day, you’ll start your morning early with breakfast before setting off on a trek from Mti Mkubwa Camp to Shira 1 Camp. This hike typically takes up to 5 hours and offers spectacular views of the west face of Kibo Volcano, the highest peak of Kilimanjaro. As you traverse the lower moorland zone, you’ll encounter large shrubs and vibrant wildflowers that add to the stunning scenery. Upon reaching Shira 1 Camp, our porters will set up your tents while the chef prepares a nourishing lunch.

After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some well-deserved time to relax and acclimate to the altitude. In the evening, your guide will hold a briefing to discuss the plans for the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re informed and ready for the adventure ahead.
This day offers not only a chance to make progress on your climb but also to appreciate the diverse flora and breathtaking views that Kilimanjaro has to offer.

days.label: SHIRA CAMP 1 | SHIRA CAMP 2
text: On the third day, you’ll start your morning with an early breakfast before embarking on a brief hike from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp. This trek typically takes about 5 to 6 hours and is relatively easy, allowing you to fully enjoy the breathtaking views of the African landscape around you. Upon arrival at Shira 2 Camp, our dedicated porters will handle all the arrangements, including pitching your tents, while the chef prepares a delicious lunch. After your meal, you’ll have the opportunity to unwind and rest until dinnertime.

In the evening, after dinner, your experienced guide will hold a briefing to discuss the trekking plans for the following day. This day not only allows for gradual acclimatization but also offers stunning panoramic vistas, making it a memorable part of your Kilimanjaro adventure.

days.label: SHIRA CAMP 2 | LAVA TOWER | BARRANCO CAMP
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route takes you to the Lava Tower at 4,630 meters, traversing through a semi-desert, rocky landscape. This demanding hike typically takes around 5 hours to reach the Lava Tower, where you’ll enjoy lunch amidst the stunning surroundings. After lunch, prepare for a descent of 680 meters to Barranco Camp, which allows your body to adjust to the higher altitude—a key advantage of acclimatization. The 2-hour descent offers breathtaking views and fantastic photo opportunities of the Western Breach, a striking feature of Kilimanjaro’s landscape.

Conclude your day with a memorable sunset and dinner at Barranco Camp, where you can reflect on the day’s achievements and recharge for the adventures ahead. This day is vital for acclimatization, helping you adapt to the altitude while enjoying the diverse and stunning terrains of Kilimanjaro.

days.label: BARRANCO CAMP | KARANGA CAMP
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. The journey may include ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that provides breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. After conquering the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic Karanga Valley, renowned for its lush vegetation and stunning vistas. Upon reaching the Karanga Campsite, our dedicated porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a satisfying lunch. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to camp. This acclimatization hike is essential for your body to adjust to the altitude and helps prepare you for the final summit push.

In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, providing the nourishment you’ll need for the upcoming challenges. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the adventure ahead. This day is vital for acclimatization, allowing you to appreciate the stunning beauty of Kilimanjaro while ensuring you are physically ready for the summit attempt.

days.label: KARANGA CAMP | BARAFU CAMP
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu Campsite. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, offering breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s crucial to focus on acclimatization to minimize the risk of altitude-related issues.

Upon reaching Barafu, our dedicated porters will handle the setup of your camp while our chef prepares a satisfying lunch. After your meal, take time to rest and recharge until dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt, covering important details about the route, challenges, safety measures, and preparations.

Make sure to rest well this evening, as the summit ascent will begin late at night. This preparation is key for a successful climb to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa, where you’ll experience the thrill of standing atop Kilimanjaro.

days.label: BARAFU CAMP | SUMMIT | MWEKA CAMP
text: On this crucial day, you’ll rise around 11:30 PM and start your ascent after enjoying some tea and biscuits. The climb begins as you head northwest, navigating through scree toward Stella Point on the crater rim. The trek to Stella Point, located at 5,685 meters, is often considered the most mentally and physically demanding portion of the climb, typically taking around 6 hours. Upon reaching Stella Point, take a brief rest to absorb the breathtaking views and, if conditions allow, witness a magnificent sunrise. The journey continues with a 2-hour snow-covered ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. Your time at the summit should be brief due to the cold and potential fatigue, so make sure to capture the moment quickly.

Afterward, you will descend back to Barafu Camp, a trek that takes about 3 hours, where you’ll have a chance for a short rest before continuing on to Mweka Camp for dinner and your overnight stay. This day is a true highlight of your Kilimanjaro adventure, culminating in a sense of accomplishment that is unmatched.

days.label: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
text: After breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where you’ll complete the trek. A comfortable drive will take you back to your Hotel, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you. At the end of your trip, tipping your guide and the support team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel.

If you’re interested in extending your adventure with a safari, our safari coordinator will be available at the hotel to discuss various options. After some well-deserved rest, you can meet with them for a briefing on the exciting safari experiences we offer. We highly recommend booking a safari with us to explore Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty, ensuring your journey is truly unforgettable.

days.label: Departure Day

Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or wish to delve into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. After summiting, you’ll descend through Kilimanjaro’s diverse ecosystems, concluding your adventure with a restful night at your hotel. Celebrate this incredible achievement with your group and reminisce about the journey.

title: Marangu Route Group Departure · 6 days · Group
metaDescription: This package offers an exhilarating experience for those looking to conquer Africa’s tallest peak as part of a group, starting with your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. Upon landing, you’ll be warmly greeted by our driver, who
overview: This package offers an exhilarating experience for those looking to conquer Africa’s tallest peak as part of a group, starting with your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. Upon landing, you’ll be warmly greeted by our driver, who will transfer you and your fellow climbers to your hotel. Here, you’ll enjoy a delicious meal and a pre-trekking briefing led by our experienced coordinators, preparing the entire group for the adventure ahead. The trek begins from Moshi, taking you and your group through the stunning landscapes of Kilimanjaro, starting in the lush rainforest and progressing to higher altitudes as you make your way toward the summit. Each day, you’ll acclimate at various camps, with our team ensuring safety, comfort, and camaraderie throughout the journey.

The ultimate highlight of the trek is the group ascent to Uhuru Peak, where you’ll share the breathtaking achievement of standing together at the highest point in Africa. After reaching the summit, the descent allows you to take in the diverse scenery alongside your team one last time.

Upon completing the trek, you’ll return to Springlands Hotel for a well-deserved rest and the opportunity to celebrate your success as a group. For those wishing to extend their journey, options for a group safari or beach relaxation in Zanzibar can be added, creating a complete and unforgettable Tanzania adventure. For more information about the trek and additional options, feel free to explore our website.

days.label: Arrival
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for a personal touch. You will then enjoy a seamless transfer to the enchanting to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you. Following this, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you valuable insights into the wonders that lie ahead during your expedition.

Take the time to unwind and enjoy the relaxing environment of your Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This setting provides the perfect opportunity to prepare for your upcoming adventure while ensuring your comfort and relaxation before you begin your trek.

days.label: Moshi to Marangu Gate | Mandara Hut
text: After breakfast, your adventure begins with a 1-hour drive from Moshi to the Marangu Gate, where you’ll complete the necessary registration formalities. Once the paperwork is done, you’ll embark on your trek through the lush rainforest. The trail to Mandara Hut, your first camp, involves a steady uphill hike, providing opportunities to spot playful monkeys and various wildlife along the way.

Upon reaching Mandara, you’ll be welcomed with a warm meal and settle into comfortable A-frame huts for the night. In the evening, you can opt for a short acclimatization hike to Maundi Crater, where you can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. This hike not only aids in acclimatization but also allows you to soak in the beauty of your surroundings before continuing your trek .

days.label: Mandara Hut to Horombo Hut
text: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at Mandara Hut, fueling up for the exciting trek ahead. As you continue your journey, you’ll traverse through the lush rainforest before transitioning into the moorland zone. The ascent showcases a gradual change in vegetation, giving way to a more rugged and open landscape. This 6-hour trek to Horombo Hut offers stunning views of both Kibo and Mawenzi peaks, making it a memorable leg of your adventure.

Upon arrival at Horombo Hut, you’ll be greeted with a warm meal, giving you the chance to relax and acclimate to the higher altitude. In the evening, your guide will provide a comprehensive briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring that you’re well-prepared for the challenges ahead. This preparation is key to successfully navigating the upcoming stages of your climb.

days.label: Acclimatization Day at Horombo Hut
text: To assist with acclimatization, you’ll spend an extra day at Horombo Hut, allowing your body more time to adjust to the increasing altitude. This crucial acclimatization day provides the option to either relax at the camp or embark on a short hike to Zebra Rocks, a striking geological feature situated at 3,980 meters above sea level. This acclimatization hike is designed to help your body better cope with the upcoming higher elevations, significantly reducing the risk of altitude sickness.

After your hike, you’ll return to camp for a hearty meal, providing you with the energy needed for the next stages of your journey. In the evening, you’ll have the opportunity to discuss the plans for the next day’s ascent with your guide, ensuring that you’re fully prepared for the challenges ahead. This day is essential for enhancing your chances of a successful summit attempt by allowing your body to acclimatize properly.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
text: Today’s trek takes you across the expansive lunar desert known as the Saddle, a rugged and barren landscape stretching between the Kibo and Mawenzi peaks. Although the terrain may seem stark and desolate, the awe-inspiring views of the towering peaks on either side are a highlight of this journey. The hike typically takes around 6 hours, allowing plenty of time to soak in the vastness of the landscape and appreciate the unique beauty of this high-altitude environment.

Upon reaching Kibo Hut, you’ll settle in for an early dinner and some much-needed rest, conserving your energy for the upcoming summit attempt. In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing to prepare you for the final ascent, which will begin just before midnight. This briefing is essential, as it covers the route, safety measures, and what to expect during the challenging climb ahead. Proper preparation and rest are crucial for a successful summit bid.

days.label: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut

stats.Altitude: : 4,700 meters (15,419 feet) – 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)

text: Around midnight, you’ll be awakened to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. The journey to Gillman’s Point at 5,685 meters is steep and strenuous, typically taking around six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will test your endurance, but your guide will offer support and encouragement along the way.

Once you reach Gillman’s Point, you’ll traverse the crater rim toward Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If the weather cooperates, you’ll be rewarded with a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, a truly unforgettable sight. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll descend back to Kibo Hut for a short rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night, allowing your body to recover after the exhilarating challenge.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
text: After breakfast, you’ll start your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. As you trek downward, take in the final views of the landscape and reflect on your accomplishment. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll be presented with your well-earned summit certificate as a testament to your achievement.

From there, you’ll be driven back to your Hotel in Moshi, where a hot meal, a refreshing shower, and a comfortable bed await you. If you’re interested in extending your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator to explore options like a thrilling wildlife safari or a relaxing trip to the stunning beaches of Zanzibar. This is the perfect way to celebrate your successful climb and enjoy more of what Tanzania has to offer!

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you wish to extend your adventure, you can add a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, feel free to visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or delving into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar has something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion. If you’re interested in adding a safari experience, please visit our Safari page for more information on our exciting safari options. This will ensure your Tanzanian adventure is truly unforgettable!

title: Rongai Route Group Departure · 7 days · Group
metaDescription: Embark on a thrilling group adventure up Mount Kilimanjaro via the scenic Rongai Route, renowned for its unique and less-traveled path. Starting from the northern side of the mountain near the Kenyan border, this route provides trekkers wit
overview: Embark on a thrilling group adventure up Mount Kilimanjaro via the scenic Rongai Route, renowned for its unique and less-traveled path. Starting from the northern side of the mountain near the Kenyan border, this route provides trekkers with stunning, varied landscapes and a quieter experience. Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by our driver and transferred to the hotel for a relaxing night, including a pre-trek briefing with your guides.

The group trek begins at the Rongai Gate, where you will journey through beautiful pine forests and open moorlands while gradually ascending. You will acclimate at designated camps along the route, including the breathtaking Mawenzi Tarn, ensuring a safe and steady climb. The ultimate highlight is reaching Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa, where you will celebrate this unforgettable achievement as a group.

After your successful summit, you will descend through the lush rainforest trails to the Mweka Gate. Completing the trek, the group will return to the hotel to rest and reflect on the shared adventure. For those looking to extend their journey, options for group safaris or a relaxing beach vacation in Zanzibar are available, providing the perfect conclusion to your Tanzanian adventure.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to greet you, holding a sign with your name for a warm and heartfelt welcome. Following this, you’ll enjoy a seamless and comfortable transfer to your Hotel. Once you arrive at the hotel, you will be treated to a delicious meal to kick off your adventure.

Later in the day, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This session is an exciting opportunity to learn about the wonders that await you on your upcoming expedition.
You can unwind in the relaxing environment of Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, and a bar and restaurant, setting the perfect tone for your adventure ahead.

days.label: Moshi to Rongai Gate | Simba Camp
text: After enjoying breakfast at the hotel, you’ll embark on a scenic 2 to 3-hour drive to the Rongai Gate, where you’ll be surrounded by picturesque farmlands and rural villages. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll complete the registration process before commencing your trek through lush farmlands and serene pine forests.

The trail begins with a gentle ascent, which allows you to gradually acclimatize to the altitude. Keep an eye out for wildlife, including the playful colobus monkeys that may cross your path. The peaceful surroundings serve as a wonderful introduction to the diverse landscapes of Kilimanjaro.
Once you arrive at Simba Camp, you’ll be welcomed with a hot meal, providing nourishment and comfort as you settle in for the night, preparing for the adventures that lie ahead.

days.label: Trek to Kikelewa Camp
text: Begin your day with a steady ascent to the Second Cave, where you’ll stop for a delicious lunch. Afterward, continue your journey across the moorland, following a smaller path that leads you closer to the jagged peaks of Mawenzi. This section of the trek is particularly beautiful, offering stunning views and a profound sense of isolation as you navigate the unique terrain.

After approximately 10 kilometers, you’ll arrive at Kikelewa Camp, nestled in a sheltered valley adorned with towering giant Senecios and near the Kikelewa Cave. This camp serves as an ideal resting spot, allowing you to acclimatize to the altitude while soaking in the breathtaking scenery. Take this opportunity to relax, enjoy your surroundings, and prepare mentally and physically for the challenges that await in the coming days.

days.label: Trek to Mawenzi Tarn
text: Today’s trek is shorter but steeper, leading you through grassy slopes toward the stunning Mawenzi Tarn, which is nestled beneath the towering cliffs of Mawenzi Peak. The campsite is set in a dramatic and picturesque landscape, offering breathtaking views in every direction.

Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted with a hot lunch, providing a refreshing break after your ascent. You’ll have the opportunity to relax and soak in the serene surroundings or take a short acclimatization hike to help your body adjust to the altitude. This is crucial for preparing for the higher elevations you’ll encounter in the upcoming days.

In the evening, you’ll enjoy a delicious dinner, followed by an informative briefing from your guide. This briefing will prepare you for the next day’s trek to higher altitudes, ensuring you’re equipped with the knowledge and confidence needed for the challenges ahead.

days.label: Acclimatization Day at Mawenzi Tarn
text: This extra day at Mawenzi Tarn is crucial for acclimatization. Take the opportunity to hike toward Mawenzi Peak, which not only helps your body adjust to the higher altitude but also offers splendid views of the surrounding landscape. The hike is designed to acclimatize you to the thinner air, preparing you for the more demanding stages of your trek.

After your hike, return to Mawenzi Tarn to rest and relax. This rest day is vital for building the stamina needed for the challenging trek ahead to Kibo Hut. During this time, it’s essential to stay well-hydrated and focused, as proper preparation is key for your upcoming summit attempt. Embrace this day as a chance to enjoy the stunning scenery while ensuring your body is ready for the final push.

days.label: Mawenzi Tarn Hut to Kibo Hut
text: After breakfast, you’ll embark on a trek across the vast, barren lunar landscape known as the “Saddle,” which stretches between Mawenzi and Kibo peaks. The terrain here is desolate yet mesmerizing, featuring rugged vistas with the summit looming ahead in the distance. Although the trail is long, it maintains a gentle incline, allowing for a steady pace as you approach the final stage of your journey.

Upon arriving at Kibo Hut, you’ll have the opportunity to rest and enjoy an early dinner to conserve energy for the summit attempt. Your guide will provide a detailed briefing about the ascent to Uhuru Peak, which begins shortly after midnight. This preparation is crucial as you gear up for the final push toward Africa’s highest point.

days.label: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut

stats.Altitude: 4,700 meters (15,419 feet) – 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)

text: Around midnight, you’ll be awakened to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. This journey to Gillman’s Point, at 5,685 meters, is steep and strenuous, typically taking about six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will test your endurance, but your guide will be there to offer support along the way.

Upon reaching Gillman’s Point, you’ll traverse the crater rim toward Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If the weather cooperates, you’ll be rewarded with a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, an experience that many climbers describe as life-changing. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll descend to Kibo Hut for a short rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night, where you can reflect on your remarkable journey.
This day will be one of the most challenging yet rewarding parts of your trek, so make sure you stay hydrated and pace yourself throughout the ascent!

days.label: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
text: After breakfast, you’ll start your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. As you trek downward, take in the final views of the landscape and reflect on your incredible accomplishment. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll receive your well-earned summit certificate as a testament to your achievement.

Following this, you’ll be driven back to the Hotel in Moshi, where a hot meal, refreshing shower, and comfortable bed await you. If you’re interested in extending your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator to explore options such as a thrilling wildlife safari or a relaxing trip to the stunning beaches of Zanzibar. This is the perfect opportunity to celebrate your trek and discover more of Tanzania’s beauty!

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you wish to extend your adventure, you may consider adding a day trip to your itinerary to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more details, we invite you to visit our Day Trip page. Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or delving into the island’s rich culture, Zanzibar offers something for everyone. Explore our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next excursion.

If you’re interested in adding a safari experience to your journey, please visit our Safari page for more information on our exciting safari options. This is a wonderful opportunity to create unforgettable memories in Tanzania!

title: Shira Route Group Departure · 7 days · Group
metaDescription: Your adventure begins upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where our driver will warmly greet you and your group and transfer you to your hotel. After enjoying a delightful meal and a pre-trekking briefing from your guide and
overview: Your adventure begins upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where our driver will warmly greet you and your group and transfer you to your hotel. After enjoying a delightful meal and a pre-trekking briefing from your guide and mountain coordinators, you can relax and take advantage of the hotel’s amenities, including the swimming pool, garden, and restaurant.

On Day 2, you’ll travel as a group to Londorossi Park Gate to begin your hike to Shira 1 Camp. Over the following days, you’ll trek through stunning landscapes, including the ascent of the Barranco Wall and the Lava Tower, before reaching Barafu Camp, where you’ll prepare for the summit attempt.

On Day 7, you’ll rise early with the group for the challenging summit ascent to Uhuru Peak, experiencing a breathtaking sunrise before descending to Mweka Camp. After completing the climb, you’ll return to Mweka Gate and transfer back to Springlands Hotel for a hot meal and a refreshing shower.

To extend your adventure, your group can opt for a safari or explore Zanzibar’s beautiful beaches and rich culture. For more information, please visit our Day Trip and Safari pages or check out our Zanzibar options for additional excursions.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for easy identification. This seamless and comfortable transfer service will take you to the charming Hotel.

At the hotel, you will be welcomed with a delicious meal. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing. This is an exciting opportunity to learn about the upcoming adventure and the wonders that await you on your trek.
Take advantage of the relaxing environment at the Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring you start your journey on a comfortable note.

days.label: Moshi to Londorossi Gate then Shira 1

stats.Altitude: 890 meters (2,920 feet) - 3,505 meters (11,500 feet) above sea level.

text: After enjoying breakfast at Hotel and receiving essential instructions from your guide, you’ll embark on a 1.5-hour drive to Londorossi Park Gate (2250m). Following your guide’s advice is crucial for avoiding altitude sickness, as you’ll be climbing to significant elevations, with your first night at Shira 1 Camp.

At Londorossi Gate, you’ll complete a brief registration before entering the national park. Following this, you’ll have a short drive along Shira Road to the Moram Picnic Site, which takes about 45 minutes. From there, you’ll start your 7 km hike to Shira 1 Camp, typically taking 3 to 4 hours depending on your pace. You’ll have a restful overnight stay at Shira 1, preparing for the next day’s trek to Shira 2 Camp.
This day sets the tone for your journey, allowing you to acclimatize while enjoying the stunning scenery along the way.

days.label: Trek from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp
text: On this day, you’ll wake up early for breakfast before starting the brief hike from Shira 1 to Shira 2 Camp. This trek typically takes 5 to 6 hours and is considered relatively easy, allowing you to take in the breathtaking views of the African landscape.

Upon reaching the Shira 2 campsite, our dedicated porters will handle all arrangements, including pitching tents while our chef prepares your lunch. After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some time to unwind and rest until dinnertime.
In the evening, after dinner, our experienced guide will brief you about the trekking plans for the following day, ensuring you are well-prepared for the next leg of your adventure.
This day is perfect for acclimatization and enjoying the spectacular surroundings, making it a memorable part of your Kilimanjaro journey.

days.label: Trek from Shira 2 Camp to Barranco Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route includes a climb to Lava Tower at 4,630m, where you’ll pass through a semi-desert, rocky landscape. After a 5-hour hike, you’ll enjoy lunch at Lava Tower, giving you a chance to recharge before ascending the rocky scree path. This demanding day might test your endurance as you acclimatize to the higher altitude.

Following lunch, you’ll descend 680m to Barranco Camp, where you’ll truly experience the benefits of acclimatization. This 2-hour descent offers stunning photo opportunities of the Western Breach, a dramatic cliff face that adds to the day’s breathtaking scenery. End the day with a memorable sunset and dinner at Barranco Camp, surrounded by the incredible landscapes that make your Kilimanjaro adventure truly unforgettable.
This day is designed to help you acclimatize properly while enjoying the stunning beauty of the mountain.

days.label: Trek from Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s journey may involve ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that offers spectacular views as you climb. After conquering the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic Karanga Valley, known for its lush vegetation and breathtaking landscapes. This descent allows for beautiful photo opportunities while you take in the stunning surroundings.

Upon reaching the Karanga campsite, our dedicated porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch for you. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to camp. This acclimatization effort is essential to prepare your body for the higher altitudes ahead. In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, providing you with the energy needed for the next day’s challenges. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the adventure that lies ahead.
This day is crucial for acclimatization and serves as a perfect balance of challenging ascents and well-deserved relaxation amidst nature’s beauty.

days.label: Trek from Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp
text: Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu campsite. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, providing breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s crucial to focus on acclimatization to avoid altitude-related issues, which can impact your trekking experience significantly. Upon reaching Barafu, our porters will efficiently handle camp setup while our chef prepares a nutritious lunch to replenish your energy. After eating, take some time to rest and prepare mentally and physically for the challenges ahead.

In the evening, your guide will conduct a detailed briefing on the upcoming summit attempt, covering the route, challenges, safety measures, and essential preparations to ensure your success. This is a vital moment to clarify any questions you may have and to solidify your plans for the summit.

Try to rest well during the day, as the summit ascent will begin late in the evening, and a good night’s sleep will be crucial for your performance during this critical stage of your adventure.This day is pivotal for building the stamina and mental strength needed for the final climb, and every effort you make here will contribute to your success on the summit.

days.label: Summit Attempt - Uhuru Peak
text: You’ll rise around 11:30 PM to begin your ascent after enjoying some tea and biscuits. The trek will lead you northwest as you climb through scree towards Stella Point on the crater rim. This 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5685m)

is often considered the most mentally and physically challenging part of the climb, testing your endurance and determination. After a brief rest at Stella Point, you will be rewarded with a magnificent sunrise, weather permitting, as you take in the stunning views. From Stella Point, you will embark on a 2-hour ascent across a snow-covered path to Uhuru Peak, the highest point on Mount Kilimanjaro.

Be mindful that your time at the summit may be limited due to cold temperatures and fatigue, so it’s important not to linger too long. The descent back to Barafu Camp takes about 3 hours, where you will have a short rest before continuing your journey to Mweka Camp for dinner and an overnight stay.
This day is the culmination of your efforts and will offer unforgettable views and a sense of achievement as you stand atop Africa’s highest peak.

days.label: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
text: After enjoying breakfast at Mweka Camp, you will begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where your trek concludes. Following the completion of your hike, a transfer will take you back to your Hotel, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you, providing the perfect opportunity to relax and celebrate your accomplishment.

As your trip comes to an end, please consider showing your appreciation to the trekking team with a tip. Special envelopes for this purpose are available at the hotel, ensuring that your gratitude reaches those who supported you on your journey.

If you wish to extend your adventure, you can meet with our safari coordinator at the hotel. After some rest, they will provide a briefing on various safari options available, allowing you to experience Tanzania’s stunning wildlife and natural beauty. We highly recommend booking a safari with us, as it will truly make your journey unforgettable.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred back to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. This is a great time to reflect on your incredible journey and the unforgettable experiences you’ve had in Tanzania. If you’re looking to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to your itinerary, where you can explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. More details can be found on our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you may wish to continue your travels with a visit to the stunning island of Zanzibar. Whether you seek relaxation on pristine beaches or an exploration of the island’s vibrant culture, Zanzibar has something for every traveler. For more information on the perfect package for your next excursion, visit our Zanzibar page. You can also consider booking a safari to experience Tanzania’s renowned wildlife. Our Safari page offers detailed information on various options, ensuring you capture the breathtaking natural beauty and wildlife that this incredible country has to offer.

title: Luxury Tanzania Wildlife Safari
metaDescription: Experience an amazing week exploring Tanzania’s famous wildlife and stunning landscapes. Your adventure starts with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport, followed by a relaxing evening at the Salinero Hotel (or similar). On your
overview: Experience an amazing week exploring Tanzania’s famous wildlife and stunning landscapes. Your adventure starts with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport, followed by a relaxing evening at the Salinero Hotel (or similar). On your first day, visit Lake Manyara National Park, known for its tree-climbing lions, before spending the night in Karatu.

Continue to the Serengeti, where you’ll see incredible wildlife like lions, elephants, and cheetahs on its vast plains. After a full day in the Serengeti, head to the Ngorongoro Crater, a world-famous spot for close-up wildlife viewing. End your safari at Tarangire National Park, known for its elephants and beautiful scenery.

After a rewarding trip, unwind back at Salinero Hotel and then transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport. You can also add a day trip or extend your journey with a visit to Zanzibar for more adventure.

days.label: Arrival
text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

Later in the day, join our experienced safari coordinators for a pre-safari briefing, where you’ll learn more about the exciting adventures ahead. Unwind and relax in the peaceful surroundings of the hotel, which features amenities like a swimming pool, lush gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. It’s the perfect start to your unforgettable Tanzanian journey!

days.label: Manyara National Park - Exploration
text: After breakfast, begin your journey to the scenic Lake Manyara National Park. This park is a gem for nature lovers, offering a variety of ecosystems and stunning landscapes. It’s well-known for its rare tree-climbing lions and diverse wildlife, including elephants, giraffes, buffalo, and hippos. Around the lake, you may spot large herds of baboons, playful blue monkeys, and vervet monkeys.

Bird enthusiasts will delight in the sight of flamingos, brightly colored lilac-breasted rollers, and birds of prey soaring overhead. After an enriching day of game viewing, head to Karatu in the afternoon for an overnight stay, preparing for the adventures ahead.

days.label: Journey to Serengeti National Park
text: After breakfast, you’ll head to Serengeti, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations. The scenic drive takes you through breathtaking landscapes, transitioning into the Serengeti’s vast plains. Along the way, enjoy a game drive where you might spot lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos, and buffalos, often referred to as the “Big Five.”

Cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and many other species add to the thrill of exploring the Serengeti’s rich biodiversity. By evening, you’ll reach the Serengeti Safari Lodge or similar accommodations, where you can relax and enjoy the serene atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot to reflect on the day’s wildlife adventures and prepare for the next.

days.label: Explore Serengeti National Park
text: After breakfast, you’ll spend the day exploring Serengeti National Park. Enjoy an exciting full-day game drive, where you can spot lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and many more animals in their natural habitat. Watch for unique wildlife behaviours, like predator-prey interactions, and take in the park’s stunning landscapes.
By evening, you’ll return to your accommodation at Serengeti Safari Lodge or a similar camp, surrounded by the park’s beauty, to relax and reflect on the day’s adventures.

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater Adventure
text: After breakfast, you’ll leave the Serengeti and enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, you’ll descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for an exciting game drive. This area is home to a wide array of wildlife, including lions, rhinos, elephants, and flamingos, offering an unforgettable safari experience.

The crater’s diverse ecosystems provide excellent wildlife viewing opportunities, making it one of the top destinations in the world for animal sightings. After a full day of exploration, you’ll head to Karatu for a restful overnight stay.

days.label: Tarangire National Park
text: After breakfast, you’ll leave Karatu and head to Tarangire National Park, famous for its exceptional wildlife sightings, especially during the dry season when large herds gather near the Tarangire River.
As you explore the park’s varied landscapes, including vast savannas and the iconic baobab trees, you’ll encounter a wide range of animals, including elephants, zebras, buffalo, and lions.

The park is also a paradise for bird watchers, with numerous species inhabiting its diverse environments. After a thrilling day of wildlife exploration, you’ll make your way to the Salinero Hotel for a peaceful evening.

days.label: Departure Day
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure. If you’d like to extend your adventure, consider adding a day trip to explore nearby attractions or immerse yourself in local culture. For more information, visit our Day Trip page.

Alternatively, you can continue your journey with a trip to the beautiful island of Zanzibar. Whether you’re looking to relax on its pristine beaches or explore its vibrant culture, Zanzibar has something for every traveler. Check out our Zanzibar page to find the perfect package for your next getaway.

title: Ultimate Tanzania Safari Experience
metaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable adventure through Tanzania’s iconic landscapes with our carefully crafted 8-day itinerary. Your journey begins at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where our dedicated driver welcomes you for a smooth transfer to
overview: Embark on an unforgettable adventure through Tanzania’s iconic landscapes with our carefully crafted 8-day itinerary. Your journey begins at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where our dedicated driver welcomes you for a smooth transfer to your hotel. After a delicious meal and an insightful pre-trekking briefing, take some time to relax by the pool or explore the lush gardens of your accommodation. The next day, set out to Tarangire National Park, renowned for its remarkable wildlife viewing opportunities, including elephants, zebras, and a plethora of bird species. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at Endoro Lodge or similar, where you can prepare for the adventures ahead.

As you continue your safari experience, you’ll visit stunning Lake Natron, a vital breeding ground for flamingos, followed by the legendary Serengeti National Park, famous for its vast savannahs and incredible wildlife sightings. Spend two full days in the Serengeti, immersing yourself in thrilling game drives and the captivating Great Migration.

The journey also includes a visit to the Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage site, where diverse wildlife abounds against a breathtaking backdrop. Finally, conclude your adventure at Lake Manyara National Park, known for its tree-climbing lions and vibrant birdlife, before returning to Moshi. Your departure day offers options to extend your experience with day trips or a relaxing beach getaway in Zanzibar. This itinerary promises unforgettable moments in Tanzania’s stunning wilderness, making it perfect for nature enthusiasts and adventure seekers alike.

days.label: Arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name for a warm welcome. From there, you will enjoy a seamless and comfortable transfer to your Hotel.

Upon arrival, you’ll be served a delicious meal to replenish your energy. Later, our experienced safari coordinators will provide a pre-trekking briefing, offering valuable insights into the wonders that await you on your expedition.
Take the time to relax in the inviting atmosphere of your Hotel, featuring a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant, ensuring a pleasant start to your adventure.

days.label: Tarangire National Park
text: Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river.

The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water. Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

days.label: Lake Natron
text: After an early breakfast, head toward Lake Natron, a unique and scenic destination in Tanzania. The journey showcases striking landscapes, from rocky hills to Maasai villages and volcanic plains. Known for its mineral-rich waters, Lake Natron is a breeding site for thousands of flamingos, which create a stunning contrast against the red-hued waters. As you explore, you’ll learn about the lake’s unique ecology, formed by high temperatures and volcanic springs, giving it its distinct color and salinity.
After exploring Lake Natron’s fascinating ecosystem and scenic beauty, return to your lodge for a restful evening. Prepare for more incredible experiences on your safari journey.

days.label: Serengeti national park
text: After breakfast, set off toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. The route takes you through the rugged and beautiful landscapes surrounding the park, giving you glimpses of Maasai villages and the open plains that define this world-famous ecosystem. The Serengeti, known for its vast savannas and the renowned Great Migration, offers a chance to spot a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, cheetahs, elephants, and more.

Arrive in the Serengeti in time for an afternoon game drive, where you can experience the thrill of spotting wildlife against the park’s iconic landscapes. In the evening, unwind and enjoy dinner at your Serengeti Camp, resting up for more exploration the next day.
days.overnight: serengeti Safari Lodge, Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar

days.label: Full day in serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.
days.overnight: serengeti Safari Lodge, Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater
text: Start with an early breakfast before heading to Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage site and a remarkable wildlife haven. Descend into the crater floor, where the rich biodiversity provides exceptional wildlife viewing throughout the year. Expect sightings of black rhinos, elephants, large prides of lions, and hippos cooling off in pools. The landscape of lush grasslands, acacia forests, and a freshwater lake creates a scenic backdrop for your exploration.
After a memorable day within the crater, drive back to Endoro Lodge for an overnight stay, where you can relax and reflect on the day’s wildlife encounters and breathtaking views.

days.label: Manyara National Park
text: Begin the day with breakfast before heading out to Lake Manyara National Park, a beautiful reserve with landscapes ranging from dense woodlands to open plains and the picturesque soda lake. Known for its tree-climbing lions, vibrant baboon troops, and flocks of flamingos that paint the lake pink in certain seasons, Lake Manyara is a wildlife enthusiast’s haven. Bird lovers will also find plenty to admire, from pelicans and storks to colorful kingfishers.

After a memorable game drive, enjoy the final moments in this scenic park before drive back to Moshi in the late afternoon, marking the close of your unforgettable Tanzania safari adventure #### Sal salinero hotel or similar

days.label: Departure
text: On your departure day, you have the flexibility to transfer back to Kilimanjaro International Airport (KIA) or explore additional options to extend your adventure. If you’re interested in experiencing more of Tanzania, consider adding a day trip. Visit our Day Trip page to discover various excursions, including cultural experiences and scenic tours.

Alternatively, if you’re looking to relax on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar, check out our Zanzibar page for options to extend your stay on this stunning island. We’re here to help you make the most of your journey, so let us know how you’d like to proceed!
