title: Best of Classic Tanzania Safari
metaDescription: Embark on the ultimate Tanzanian adventure with our 8-day Classic Safari, a journey that captures the essence of Africa’s breathtaking wilderness. This package takes you through Tanzania’s iconic national parks and conservation areas, renow
overview: Embark on the ultimate Tanzanian adventure with our 8-day Classic Safari, a journey that captures the essence of Africa’s breathtaking wilderness. This package takes you through Tanzania’s iconic national parks and conservation areas, renowned worldwide for their abundant wildlife and stunning landscapes. From the lush forests of Lake Manyara to the vast plains of the Serengeti and the awe-inspiring Ngorongoro Crater, each destination offers unique opportunities for unforgettable wildlife encounters. With expertly guided game drives, you’ll have the chance to witness the Big Five—lions, leopards, rhinos, elephants, and buffalos—along with cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and countless bird species in their natural habitats.

Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport and ends with a departure full of cherished memories—or even a seamless transition to the pristine beaches of Zanzibar for a relaxing extension. This thoughtfully curated safari includes comfortable accommodations, like the serene Salinero Hotel and luxurious Matawi Serengeti Camp, ensuring your trip is both adventurous and rejuvenating.

Whether it’s the thrill of witnessing a lion hunt, the tranquillity of a Serengeti sunset, or the wonder of exploring the world-famous Ngorongoro Crater, this package delivers an immersive experience into Tanzania’s incredible safari tours. Perfect for first-time visitors and seasoned travelers alike, the 8 Days Classic Tanzania Safari promises a lifetime of memories in the heart of East Africa.

days.label: Arrival
text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

Later in the day, join our experienced safari coordinators for a pre-safari briefing, where you’ll learn more about the exciting adventures ahead. Unwind and relax in the peaceful surroundings of the hotel, which features amenities like a swimming pool, lush gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. It’s the perfect start to your unforgettable Tanzanian journey!

days.label: Lake Manyara National Park
text: This morning, you’ll drive to Lake Manyara National Park at the foot of the Rift Valley’s dramatic escarpment. The park is known for its diverse landscapes, including evergreen groundwater forests, acacia woodlands, grassy plains, a swampy fan delta, and the expansive lake that dominates the landscape. This variety of ecosystems creates a haven for wildlife, attracting a wide range of species. You’ll encounter buffalo, impala, giraffes, bushbuck, waterbuck, hippos, and large herds of elephants near the lake as you explore.

The park is also famous for its rare tree-climbing lions, which are often spotted lounging in the branches of acacia trees. In addition, be on the lookout for blue monkeys, vervet monkeys, and lively troops of Olive baboons as they move through the park’s diverse habitats. Lake Manyara offers excellent opportunities for game viewing, with its stunning scenery and rich wildlife providing a memorable safari experience.

days.label: Journey to Serengeti National Park
text: After breakfast, you’ll head to Serengeti, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations. The scenic drive takes you through breathtaking landscapes, transitioning into the Serengeti’s vast plains. Along the way, enjoy a game drive where you might spot lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos, and buffalos, often called the “Big Five.”

Cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and many other species add to the thrill of exploring the Serengeti’s rich biodiversity. By evening, you’ll reach the Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar accommodations, where you can relax and enjoy the serene atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot to reflect on the day’s wildlife adventures and prepare for the next.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Full day in Serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Another Full Day in Serengeti
text: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the Serengeti with another full day of exploration! Begin with an early breakfast before heading out for morning and afternoon game drives across the park’s vast plains. This second day offers a deeper chance to experience the Serengeti’s incredible wildlife, from towering giraffes grazing near acacia trees to cheetahs sprinting across open grasslands.

Your guide will take you to different areas of the park, enhancing your chances of seeing elusive species and observing unique wildlife behaviors. Pause for a picnic lunch in a scenic spot before continuing your journey through the park’s diverse habitats. As the day winds down, enjoy the breathtaking Serengeti sunset before returning to your lodge for a relaxing evening.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Morning Game Drive and Transfer to Ngorongoro
text: Start your day with a morning game drive in the Serengeti, making the most of the cooler hours when wildlife is most active. This is a great opportunity to spot predators like lions or cheetahs on the move and witness the beauty of the Serengeti one last time.

After the game drive, enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation at Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or a similar lodge, where you can relax and prepare for the next day’s adventure.
days.overnight: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or similar

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater Exploration and Transfer to Karatu
text: Start your day with an exciting journey into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Descend into this vast, natural caldera, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience a thriving ecosystem unlike any other. During your game drive, you’ll have the chance to see a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, elephants, rhinos, and large herds of wildebeest and zebras. Don’t miss the vibrant flocks of flamingos that gather along the shores of the crater’s central lake.

After a memorable day of wildlife encounters, you’ll head out of the crater and drive to the charming Karatu area. Here, you’ll settle in for a restful evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, surrounded by the serene beauty of the countryside. Relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure.

days.label: Departure or Extended Adventures
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your journey began, for your departure. Reflect on the incredible experiences and memories you’ve made during your adventure.For those wishing to extend their trip, there are exciting options available.

You can explore nearby attractions through one of the day trips featured on our Day Trip page, offering cultural, scenic, or adventurous activities. Alternatively, you can embark on a Zanzibar excursion, where you’ll enjoy pristine beaches, rich history, and vibrant culture.If you choose the Zanzibar extension, we’ll arrange your transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar on this same day. Visit our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next adventure.

After a safari briefing, you’ll have time to unwind before heading out the next day to Tarangire National Park, known for its large herds of elephants and abundant wildlife, especially around the river. On Day 3, the adventure takes you to Serengeti National Park, where you’ll witness the incredible wildlife that roams the vast plains, including lions, cheetahs, and elephants. After an exciting afternoon game drive, enjoy the serene environment before a full day of exploration on Day 4, tracking predators, herds of wildebeest, and unique landscapes.

Day 5 brings you to the Ngorongoro Crater, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience its rich biodiversity and dramatic landscapes. On Day 6, immerse yourself in the culture of Mto wa Mbu village, engaging with local communities and learning about their traditions, farming practices, and crafts.

The trip concludes on Day 7 with a flexible departure, giving you the option to explore more of Tanzania or extend your stay with a relaxing trip to Zanzibar. This itinerary offers the perfect blend of wildlife exploration and cultural immersion, providing a well-rounded Tanzanian adventure.

title: Northern Circuit Tanzania Safari
metaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable 7-day Tanzania safari adventure, starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport. Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Hotel Hotel, where you’ll get a pre-safari briefing and an introdu
overview: Embark on an unforgettable 7-day Tanzania safari adventure, starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport. Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Hotel Hotel, where you’ll get a pre-safari briefing and an introduction to Tanzania’s top wildlife destinations. The adventure kicks off with a drive to Tarangire National Park, renowned for its large elephant herds and abundant birdlife. After a night at Endoro Lodge, continue to the Serengeti, where you’ll experience a thrilling game drive in this iconic national park, home to the Great Migration and diverse wildlife. Spend a full day exploring the Serengeti’s vast savannas, tracking animals like lions, leopards, and zebras.

On Day 5, head to the Ngorongoro Crater, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” for a day of wildlife viewing in this UNESCO World Heritage Site. The journey concludes with a visit to Lake Manyara National Park, famous for its tree-climbing lions and flamingos.

After a final game drive, return to Moshi, where you’ll rest at your Hotel before your departure. Whether you choose to extend your trip with cultural experiences, scenic tours, or a relaxing stay in Zanzibar, this safari offers a perfect mix of wildlife, nature, and adventure in Tanzania.

days.label: Arrival
text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

Later in the day, join our experienced safari coordinators for a pre-safari briefing, where you’ll learn more about the exciting adventures ahead. Unwind and relax in the peaceful surroundings of the hotel, which features amenities like a swimming pool, lush gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. It’s the perfect start to your unforgettable Tanzanian journey!

days.label: Tarangire National Park
text: Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river.

The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

days.label: Serengeti national park
text: After breakfast, set off toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. The route takes you through the rugged and beautiful landscapes surrounding the park, giving you glimpses of Maasai villages and the open plains that define this world-famous ecosystem.
The Serengeti, known for its vast savannas and the renowned Great Migration, offers a chance to spot a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, cheetahs, elephants, and more.

Arrive in the Serengeti in time for an afternoon game drive, where you can experience the thrill of spotting wildlife against the park’s iconic landscapes. In the evening, unwind and enjoy dinner at your Serengeti Camp, resting up for more exploration the next day.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Full day in Serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

Upon arrival, descend into the crater to witness its incredible wildlife and striking landscapes. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” is teeming with diverse animals, including elephants, lions, rhinos, and flamingos.

After an unforgettable day of exploring the crater, drive to the nearby Karatu area and check into Endoro Lodge or similar, where you can relax and reflect on your remarkable experiences in the heart of Tanzania’s wildlife.

days.label: Manyara National Park
text: Begin the day with breakfast before heading out to Lake Manyara National Park, a beautiful reserve with landscapes ranging from dense woodlands to open plains and the picturesque Soda Lake.

Known for its tree-climbing lions, vibrant baboon troops, and flocks of flamingos that paint the lake pink in certain seasons, Lake Manyara is a wildlife enthusiast’s haven. Bird lovers will also find plenty to admire, from pelicans and storks to colourful kingfishers.
After a memorable game drive, enjoy the final moments in this scenic park before drive back to Moshi in the late afternoon, marking the close of your unforgettable Tanzania safari adventure.

days.label: Departure or Extended Adventures
text: On your departure day, you have the flexibility to transfer back to Kilimanjaro International Airport (KIA) or explore additional options to extend your adventure. If you’re interested in experiencing more of Tanzania, consider adding a day trip. Visit our Day Trip page to discover various excursions, including cultural experiences and scenic tours.

Alternatively, if you’re looking to relax on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar, check out our Zanzibar page for options to extend your stay on this stunning island. We’re here to help you make the most of your journey, so let us know how you’d like to proceed!

title: Serengeti wildebeest migration Experience
metaDescription: Embark on a thrilling journey through Tanzania’s iconic wildlife destinations with our Serengeti Wildebeest Migration Safari, this tour can be done from June to October. Beginning with your arrival in Tanzania, you’ll be warmly welcomed and
overview: Embark on a thrilling journey through Tanzania’s iconic wildlife destinations with our Serengeti Wildebeest Migration Safari, this tour can be done from June to October. Beginning with your arrival in Tanzania, you’ll be warmly welcomed and transferred to the serene Salinero Hotel. After a pre-safari briefing, the adventure begins with a visit to Tarangire National Park, known for its elephants, zebras, and towering baobabs.

Experience the rich culture of the Hadzabe and Datoga tribes at Lake Eyasi, offering a unique cultural immersion before heading to the Serengeti. The highlight of your journey is witnessing the Great Migration at the Mara River, where herds of wildebeest and zebras cross in one of nature’s most awe-inspiring spectacles. Along the way, enjoy exciting game drives, luxurious accommodations, and the chance to spot the Big Five in the wild.

From the heart of the Serengeti to the UNESCO-listed Ngorongoro Crater, this safari offers unparalleled wildlife experiences. Spend full days exploring the Serengeti, watching lions, leopards, and elephants in their natural habitat. Visit the Ngorongoro Crater, home to a diverse range of animals, and enjoy a relaxing stay in the beautiful Karatu area.

For those looking to extend their adventure, options include day trips or a visit to Zanzibar’s pristine beaches. This safari package is perfect for those seeking an unforgettable Tanzanian adventure, rich in culture, wildlife, and scenic beauty.

text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

days.label: Cultural Exploration at Lake Eyasi
text: Start your day with a scenic drive to the shores of Lake Eyasi, a remote and tranquil area that offers a unique cultural and scenic experience. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the fascinating traditions of the Hadzabe and Datoga communities. The Hadzabe, one of the last remaining hunter-gatherer tribes in East Africa, will share their way of life with you through interactive activities like learning their hunting techniques, using traditional bows and arrows, and discovering how they gather food from the surrounding wilderness. This rare opportunity provides deep insight into a lifestyle that has remained unchanged for centuries.

Next, visit the Datoga people, skilled pastoralists and blacksmiths, who will showcase their metalworking skills, including crafting tools and ornaments from recycled materials. Their rich traditions and hospitality will leave a lasting impression. After engaging with these vibrant cultures, enjoy the stunning views of Lake Eyasi’s tranquil waters and surrounding landscapes, a serene contrast to the bustling wildlife safaris. Conclude your day with a relaxing evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, reflecting on the unique cultural encounters and natural beauty you’ve experienced.

days.label: Journey to the North Serengeti
text: After breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up for a scenic drive to Serengeti, passing through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, you’ll stop at Olduvai Gorge, a fascinating archaeological site known as the “Cradle of Mankind,” where you can learn about the history of early humans.

Upon entering Serengeti, you’ll be greeted by the sight of the Great Migration, where wildebeests, zebras, and gazelles roam across the plains. The park’s diverse landscapes are home to the Big Five and many other species. In the evening, you’ll arrive at Ikoma Wild Camp, where you can enjoy a thrilling night game drive, observing the Serengeti’s nocturnal wildlife in its natural habitat.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Witness the Great Migration at Mara River
text: After breakfast, you’ll head to the Mara River in the Northern Serengeti, where the incredible Great Migration unfolds. Watch in awe as massive herds of wildebeest and zebras cross the river in search of fresh grazing grounds. This dramatic event is a highlight of the Serengeti, and you may even spot crocodiles lying in wait or a variety of bird species in the area.

After an unforgettable day witnessing one of nature’s most spectacular events, you’ll return to Ikoma Wild Camp for a relaxing evening. Enjoy a sundowner experience at the camp, sipping a drink as you watch the stunning Serengeti sunset.

text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your journey began, for your departure. You can explore nearby attractions through one of the day trips featured on our Day Trip page, offering cultural, scenic, or adventurous activities.

Alternatively, you can embark on a Zanzibar excursion, where you’ll enjoy pristine beaches, rich history, and vibrant culture.If you choose the Zanzibar extension, we’ll arrange your transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar on this same day. title: Tanzania wildlife Tours
metaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable Tanzanian journey with this carefully crafted itinerary, designed to showcase the best of the country’s breathtaking landscapes and diverse wildlife. Starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport,
overview: Embark on an unforgettable Tanzanian journey with this carefully crafted itinerary, designed to showcase the best of the country’s breathtaking landscapes and diverse wildlife. Starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport, your adventure takes you to iconic destinations like Tarangire National Park, the renowned Ngorongoro Crater, and Lake Manyara National Park.

From close encounters with elephants and tree-climbing lions to stunning vistas and rich birdlife, each day promises unique and immersive experiences. This itinerary is perfect for first-time travelers seeking the ultimate safari adventure in Tanzania.

At Tanzania Wildlife Adventures, we understand that every traveler’s dream safari is unique. That’s why we offer the flexibility to customize your trip, allowing you to tailor your experience to match your preferences.

While this itinerary is a favourite among our clients, we’re happy to work with you to design a personalized journey, whether it’s a private safari, cultural tour, or an extended trip to Zanzibar’s pristine beaches. Let us create a once-in-a-lifetime adventure that perfectly suits your needs and showcases the beauty of Tanzania’s safari destinations.

days.label: Arrival
text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

Later in the day, join our experienced safari coordinators for a pre-safari briefing, where you’ll learn more about the exciting adventures ahead. Unwind and relax in the peaceful surroundings of the hotel, which features amenities like a swimming pool, lush gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. It’s the perfect start to your unforgettable Tanzanian journey!

days.label: Tarangire National Park
text: Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river.

The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater exploration
text: After breakfast, journey to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area for a thrilling day exploring the iconic Ngorongoro Crater. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” is a haven for wildlife and boasts breathtaking landscapes.

Descend into the crater’s unique ecosystem to encounter a diverse range of animals, including elephants, lions, rhinos, and flamingos. The crater floor, with its lush grasslands, soda lakes, and acacia woodlands, provides an unparalleled setting for wildlife viewing.

Spend the day immersed in this natural wonder, marveling at the coexistence of predator and prey in a confined yet thriving ecosystem. After a day filled with unforgettable wildlife encounters, ascend from the crater and drive to Karatu, where you’ll relax and prepare for the adventures ahead.

days.label: Manyara National Park
text: Begin the day with breakfast before heading out to Lake Manyara National Park, a beautiful reserve with landscapes ranging from dense woodlands to open plains and the picturesque Soda Lake.

Known for its tree-climbing lions, vibrant baboon troops, and flocks of flamingos that paint the lake pink in certain seasons, Lake Manyara is a wildlife enthusiast’s haven. Bird lovers will also find plenty to admire, from pelicans and storks to colourful kingfishers.
After a memorable game drive, enjoy the final moments in this scenic park before drive back to Moshi in the late afternoon, marking the close of your unforgettable Tanzania safari adventure

days.label: Departure
text: On your departure day, you have the flexibility to transfer back to Kilimanjaro International Airport (KIA) or explore additional options to extend your adventure. If you’re interested in experiencing more of Tanzania, consider adding a day trip. Visit our Day Trip page to discover various excursions, including cultural experiences and scenic tours.

Alternatively, if you’re looking to relax on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar, check out our Zanzibar page for options to extend your stay on this stunning island. We’re here to help you make the most of your journey, so let us know how you’d like to proceed!

title: Climbing Kilimanjaro and Safari Comb
metaDescription: This 15-day adventure combines a thrilling Kilimanjaro climb with an unforgettable safari experience, perfectly suited for those seeking both the challenge of summiting Africa’s highest peak and the wonder of Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife
overview: This 15-day adventure combines a thrilling Kilimanjaro climb with an unforgettable safari experience, perfectly suited for those seeking both the challenge of summiting Africa’s highest peak and the wonder of Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife. The trek begins with a scenic transfer to your hotel in Moshi, followed by a pre-trekking briefing to prepare for the climb.

Over the next few days, you’ll ascend through lush rainforests and alpine deserts, reaching the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro, Uhuru Peak, on Day 6. After descending, you’ll be ready for the next phase of your adventure—a safari. For the best experience, we recommend scheduling your safari between June and October, as this period aligns with the spectacular Great Migration in the Serengeti.

On safari, you’ll explore Tarangire National Park, where you’ll witness wildlife congregating around water sources, before experiencing the cultural richness of Lake Eyasi with the Hadzabe and Datoga tribes. Your journey continues to the Serengeti, where the migration spectacle unfolds across the plains. Witness massive herds of wildebeests and zebras crossing the Mara River, a breathtaking sight.

The final part of your safari takes you to the Ngorongoro Crater, home to an abundance of wildlife in one of the world’s most unique ecosystems. Whether you’re trekking to the top of Kilimanjaro or exploring the vast landscapes of Tanzania, this adventure promises an unparalleled combination of natural beauty and cultural immersion.

days.label: Arrival
text: As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for a personal touch. You will then enjoy a seamless transfer to the enchanting to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you. Following this, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you valuable insights into the wonders that lie ahead during your expedition.

Take the time to unwind and enjoy the relaxing environment of your Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This setting provides the perfect opportunity to prepare for your upcoming adventure while ensuring your comfort and relaxation before you begin your trek.

days.label: Moshi to Marangu Gate | Mandara Hut
text: After breakfast, your adventure begins with a 1-hour drive from Moshi to the Marangu Gate, where you’ll complete the necessary registration formalities. Once the paperwork is done, you’ll embark on your trek through the lush rainforest. The trail to Mandara Hut, your first camp, involves a steady uphill hike, providing opportunities to spot playful monkeys and various wildlife along the way.

Upon reaching Mandara, you’ll be welcomed with a warm meal and settle into comfortable A-frame huts for the night. In the evening, you can opt for a short acclimatization hike to Maundi Crater, where you can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. This hike not only aids in acclimatization but also allows you to soak in the beauty of your surroundings before continuing your trek .

days.label: Mandara Hut to Horombo Hut
text: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at Mandara Hut, fueling up for the exciting trek ahead. As you continue your journey, you’ll traverse through the lush rainforest before transitioning into the moorland zone. The ascent showcases a gradual change in vegetation, giving way to a more rugged and open landscape. This 6-hour trek to Horombo Hut offers stunning views of both Kibo and Mawenzi peaks, making it a memorable leg of your adventure.

Upon arrival at Horombo Hut, you’ll be greeted with a warm meal, giving you the chance to relax and acclimate to the higher altitude. In the evening, your guide will provide a comprehensive briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring that you’re well-prepared for the challenges ahead. This preparation is key to successfully navigating the upcoming stages of your climb.

days.label: Acclimatization Day at Horombo Hut
text: To assist with acclimatization, you’ll spend an extra day at Horombo Hut, allowing your body more time to adjust to the increasing altitude. This crucial acclimatization day provides the option to either relax at the camp or embark on a short hike to Zebra Rocks, a striking geological feature situated at 3,980 meters above sea level. This acclimatization hike is designed to help your body better cope with the upcoming higher elevations, significantly reducing the risk of altitude sickness.

After your hike, you’ll return to camp for a hearty meal, providing you with the energy needed for the next stages of your journey. In the evening, you’ll have the opportunity to discuss the plans for the next day’s ascent with your guide, ensuring that you’re fully prepared for the challenges ahead. This day is essential for enhancing your chances of a successful summit attempt by allowing your body to acclimatize properly.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
text: Today’s trek takes you across the expansive lunar desert known as the Saddle, a rugged and barren landscape stretching between the Kibo and Mawenzi peaks. Although the terrain may seem stark and desolate, the awe-inspiring views of the towering peaks on either side are a highlight of this journey. The hike typically takes around 6 hours, allowing plenty of time to soak in the vastness of the landscape and appreciate the unique beauty of this high-altitude environment.

Upon reaching Kibo Hut, you’ll settle in for an early dinner and some much-needed rest, conserving your energy for the upcoming summit attempt. In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing to prepare you for the final ascent, which will begin just before midnight. This briefing is essential, as it covers the route, safety measures, and what to expect during the challenging climb ahead. Proper preparation and rest are crucial for a successful summit bid.

days.label: Kibo Hut | Summit Attempt | Horombo Hut

stats.Altitude: 4,700 meters (15,419 feet) – 5,895 meters (19,341 feet) – 3,720 meters (12,205 feet)

text: Around midnight, you’ll be awakened to begin the final ascent toward Uhuru Peak. The journey to Gillman’s Point at 5,685 meters is steep and strenuous, typically taking around six hours of steady climbing. This challenging section will test your endurance, but your guide will offer support and encouragement along the way.

Once you reach Gillman’s Point, you’ll traverse the crater rim toward Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. If the weather cooperates, you’ll be rewarded with a breathtaking sunrise over the continent, a truly unforgettable sight. After celebrating your incredible achievement at the summit, you’ll descend back to Kibo Hut for a short rest before continuing onward to Horombo Hut for the night, allowing your body to recover after the exhilarating challenge.

days.label: Horombo Hut to Marangu Gate | Return to Moshi
text: After breakfast, you’ll start your descent through the diverse moorland and lush rainforest zones, making your way back to Marangu Gate. As you trek downward, take in the final views of the landscape and reflect on your accomplishment. Upon reaching the gate, you’ll be presented with your well-earned summit certificate as a testament to your achievement.

From there, you’ll be driven back to your Hotel in Moshi, where a hot meal, a refreshing shower, and a comfortable bed await you. As this is a combo package, you will receive a pre-safari briefing in the late afternoon. Our safari coordinator will meet with you at the hotel to provide detailed information about your upcoming safari adventure and answer any questions you may have. This briefing will ensure you’re fully prepared for the exciting experiences ahead!

days.label: Tarangire National Park
text: Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river.

The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

days.label: Cultural Exploration at Lake Eyasi
text: Start your day with a scenic drive to the shores of Lake Eyasi, a remote and tranquil area that offers a unique cultural and scenic experience. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the fascinating traditions of the Hadzabe and Datoga communities. The Hadzabe, one of the last remaining hunter-gatherer tribes in East Africa, will share their way of life with you through interactive activities like learning their hunting techniques, using traditional bows and arrows, and discovering how they gather food from the surrounding wilderness. This rare opportunity provides deep insight into a lifestyle that has remained unchanged for centuries.

Next, visit the Datoga people, skilled pastoralists and blacksmiths, who will showcase their metalworking skills, including crafting tools and ornaments from recycled materials. Their rich traditions and hospitality will leave a lasting impression. After engaging with these vibrant cultures, enjoy the stunning views of Lake Eyasi’s tranquil waters and surrounding landscapes, a serene contrast to the bustling wildlife safaris. Conclude your day with a relaxing evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, reflecting on the unique cultural encounters and natural beauty you’ve experienced.

days.label: Journey to the North Serengeti
text: After breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up for a scenic drive to Serengeti, passing through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, you’ll stop at Olduvai Gorge, a fascinating archaeological site known as the “Cradle of Mankind,” where you can learn about the history of early humans.

Upon entering Serengeti, you’ll be greeted by the sight of the Great Migration, where wildebeests, zebras, and gazelles roam across the plains. The park’s diverse landscapes are home to the Big Five and many other species. In the evening, you’ll arrive at Ikoma Wild Camp, where you can enjoy a thrilling night game drive, observing the Serengeti’s nocturnal wildlife in its natural habitat.

days.label: Witness the Great Migration at Mara River
text: After breakfast, you’ll head to the Mara River in the Northern Serengeti, where the incredible Great Migration unfolds. Watch in awe as massive herds of wildebeest and zebras cross the river in search of fresh grazing grounds. This dramatic event is a highlight of the Serengeti, and you may even spot crocodiles lying in wait or a variety of bird species in the area. After an unforgettable day witnessing one of nature’s most spectacular events, you’ll return to Ikoma Wild Camp for a relaxing evening. Enjoy a sundowner experience at the camp, sipping a drink as you watch the stunning Serengeti sunset.

days.label: Full day in Serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

days.label: Morning Game Drive and Transfer to Ngorongoro
text: Start your day with a morning game drive in the Serengeti, making the most of the cooler hours when wildlife is most active. This is a great opportunity to spot predators like lions or cheetahs on the move and witness the beauty of the Serengeti one last time.

After the game drive, enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation at Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or a similar lodge, where you can relax and prepare for the next day’s adventure.
days.overnight: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or similar

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater Exploration and Transfer to Karatu
text: Start your day with an exciting journey into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Descend into this vast, natural caldera, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience a thriving ecosystem unlike any other. During your game drive, you’ll have the chance to see a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, elephants, rhinos, and large herds of wildebeest and zebras. Don’t miss the vibrant flocks of flamingos that gather along the shores of the crater’s central lake.

After a memorable day of wildlife encounters, you’ll head out of the crater and drive to the charming Karatu area. Here, you’ll settle in for a restful evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, surrounded by the serene beauty of the countryside. Relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure.

days.label: Departure or Extended Adventures
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your journey began, for your departure. Reflect on the incredible experiences and memories you’ve made during your adventure.

For those wishing to extend their trip, there are exciting options available. You can explore nearby attractions through one of the day trips featured on our Day Trip page, offering cultural, scenic, or adventurous activities. Alternatively, you can embark on a Zanzibar excursion, where you’ll enjoy pristine beaches, rich history, and vibrant culture.

If you choose the Zanzibar extension, we’ll arrange your transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar on this same day. Visit our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next adventure.

title: Kilimanjaro Climb and Serengeti Adventure
metaDescription: Embark on an unforgettable journey that combines the thrill of summiting Mount Kilimanjaro via the Machame Route with an exhilarating safari adventure through Tanzania’s iconic national parks. Begin your experience with a warm welcome in Mo
overview: Embark on an unforgettable journey that combines the thrill of summiting Mount Kilimanjaro via the Machame Route with an exhilarating safari adventure through Tanzania’s iconic national parks. Begin your experience with a warm welcome in Moshi, where you’ll prepare for the trek amidst serene accommodations.

The climb takes you through diverse landscapes, from lush rainforests to the breathtaking heights of Uhuru Peak, Africa’s highest summit. Along the way, expert guides and porters ensure your safety and comfort, offering a seamless and rewarding experience.

After conquering Kilimanjaro, transition to an extraordinary safari adventure that showcases Tanzania’s renowned wildlife. Explore the diverse ecosystems of Lake Manyara, the vast plains of the Serengeti, and the unique Ngorongoro Crater.

Encounter iconic wildlife such as lions, elephants, and giraffes, guided by experienced rangers who enhance every game drive. Luxurious lodges and camps provide the perfect balance of relaxation and immersion in nature. This 15-day itinerary delivers the ultimate Tanzanian experience, blending adventure, wildlife, and cultural exploration.

days.label: Arrival
text: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our attentive driver will be eagerly waiting to greet you, holding a sign with your name, prepared to extend a warm and welcoming reception. From there, you’ll experience a smooth and comfortable transfer to the Hotel.

Once you arrive at the hotel, you’ll be treated to a delicious meal to help you relax and refresh after your journey. Later, our experienced mountain coordinators and guide will meet with you for an informative pre-trek briefing, offering an exciting glimpse into the incredible adventure ahead.Immerse yourself in the serene ambiance of the Hotel, featuring a beautiful garden, a relaxing swimming pool, a bar, and a restaurant, creating the perfect environment for unwinding before your expedition begins.

days.label: Moshi to Machame Camp
text: After enjoying breakfast and a briefing at your hotel, you’ll set off on a 45-minute journey from Moshi to the Machame Park Gate. Upon arrival, the registration process will be completed, and you’ll receive your packed lunch. The adventure begins with your ascent through the vibrant rainforest, where the path may become muddy and slick if there has been recent rainfall.

The trek to Machame Camp spans roughly 11 kilometers and usually takes around six hours. In the evening, porters will prepare hot water for drinking and washing, while the cook will serve up dinner. As night falls, temperatures may drop close to freezing, so you’ll settle into your tent for a cold but fulfilling night’s rest.

days.label: Machame Camp to Shira Camp
text: After enjoying breakfast at Machame Camp, you’ll set off towards Shira Camp, covering about 5 kilometers in a journey that typically takes 4 to 5 hours. The trail begins with a steep ascent through the scenic moorland zone, where you’ll be treated to breathtaking views as you climb.

As you near Shira Camp, you’ll walk along a ridge offering spectacular vistas of the surrounding landscape. Upon arrival, the porters will set up your tents and prepare lunch. You’ll have the afternoon to relax and acclimate to the altitude before dinner, followed by a briefing from your guide on the next day’s trek.

days.label: Shira Camp to Lava Tower to Barranco Camp

stats.Altitude: 3,840 meters (12,598 feet) - 4,630 meters (15,190 feet) - 3,960 meters (12,992 feet)

text: After breakfast at Shira Camp, you’ll set off on a demanding trek to Lava Tower, ascending to an altitude of 4,630 meters. This hike spans approximately 11 kilometers and typically takes around 7 to 8 hours, featuring rocky, semi-desert terrain. Along the way, take in the panoramic views during your lunch stop at Lava Tower.

Afterward, you’ll descend to Barranco Camp, situated at 3,960 meters. This descent lasts about 2 hours and offers stunning vistas of the Western Breach. Upon reaching Barranco Camp, the team will set up your tents and prepare dinner. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventures that lie ahead.

days.label: Barranco Camp | Karanga Camp
text: Start your day early with a wake-up call, followed by a hearty breakfast to energize you for the trek ahead. You may encounter the renowned Barranco Wall, a steep ascent that offers a rewarding challenge.

Once you’ve conquered the Wall, you’ll make your way down into the picturesque Karanga Valley, celebrated for its lush greenery and stunning views. Upon arrival at the Karanga campsite, the porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a delicious lunch.

After your meal, you’ll undertake an acclimatization hike toward Barafu Camp, gaining an elevation of 200 meters before returning to your campsite. In the evening, savor a warm dinner crafted by our chef. Following your meal, your knowledgeable guide will provide a briefing on the next day’s trek, outlining the route, anticipated challenges, and essential details to help you prepare.

days.label: KARANGA CAMP | BARAFU CAMP
text: Begin your day with an early wake-up call and a substantial breakfast to prepare for your trek to Barafu campsite. The trail presents diverse terrain, featuring rocky patches and gentle inclines, all while showcasing stunning views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude scenery.

As you ascend, prioritize acclimatization to prevent altitude sickness.Upon your arrival at Barafu, our porters will take care of setting up the camp while the chef prepares a nourishing lunch. After your meal, take some time to relax until dinner.

In the evening, your guide will provide a detailed briefing regarding the forthcoming summit attempt, discussing the route, potential challenges, safety protocols, and necessary preparations. Be sure to rest well, as the summit ascent is scheduled to begin late in the evening.

days.label: BARAFU CAMP | SUMMIT | MWEKA CAMP
text: You’ll begin your ascent around 11:30 PM, starting with some tea and biscuits to fuel your energy. As you head northwest, you’ll navigate through scree on your way to Stella Point on the crater rim. This 6-hour trek to Stella Point (5,685 meters) is often considered the most mentally and physically demanding section of the climb.

Once you reach Stella Point, take a moment to enjoy the breathtaking sunrise, conditions permitting. From there, you’ll continue on a snow-covered path for an additional 2-hour climb to Uhuru Peak. Be mindful of your time at the summit, as weather conditions may dictate how long you can stay; it’s important not to linger too long due to the cold and the fatigue you’ll experience.
The descent to Barafu takes approximately 3 hours, where you’ll have a brief rest before continuing on to Mweka Camp for dinner and your overnight stay.

days.label: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
text: After enjoying breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where a vehicle will be waiting to take you back to the hotel. There, you’ll be greeted with a hot lunch and a refreshing shower, the perfect way to unwind after your trek.

At the conclusion of your journey, tipping the team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel. As this is a combo package, you will receive a pre-safari briefing in the late afternoon.

Our safari coordinator will meet with you at the hotel to provide detailed information about your upcoming safari adventure and answer any questions you may have. This briefing will ensure you’re fully prepared for the exciting experiences ahead!

days.label: Lake Manyara National Park
text: This morning, you’ll drive to Lake Manyara National Park at the foot of the Rift Valley’s dramatic escarpment. The park is known for its diverse landscapes, including evergreen groundwater forests, acacia woodlands, grassy plains, a swampy fan delta, and the expansive lake that dominates the landscape.

This variety of ecosystems creates a haven for wildlife, attracting a wide range of species. You’ll encounter buffalo, impala, giraffes, bushbuck, waterbuck, hippos, and large herds of elephants near the lake as you explore. The park is also famous for its rare tree-climbing lions, which are often spotted lounging in the branches of acacia trees.

In addition, be on the lookout for blue monkeys, vervet monkeys, and lively troops of Olive baboons as they move through the park’s diverse habitats. Lake Manyara offers excellent opportunities for game viewing, with its stunning scenery and rich wildlife providing a memorable safari experience.

days.label: Journey to Serengeti National Park
text: After breakfast, you’ll head to Serengeti, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations. The scenic drive takes you through breathtaking landscapes, transitioning into the Serengeti’s vast plains. Along the way, enjoy a game drive where you might spot lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos, and buffalos, often called the “Big Five.”

Cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and many other species add to the thrill of exploring the Serengeti’s rich biodiversity. By evening, you’ll reach the Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar accommodations, where you can relax and enjoy the serene atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot to reflect on the day’s wildlife adventures and prepare for the next.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Full day in Serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Another Full Day in Serengeti
text: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the Serengeti with another full day of exploration! Begin with an early breakfast before heading out for morning and afternoon game drives across the park’s vast plains. This second day offers a deeper chance to experience the Serengeti’s incredible wildlife, from towering giraffes grazing near acacia trees to cheetahs sprinting across open grasslands.

Your guide will take you to different areas of the park, enhancing your chances of seeing elusive species and observing unique wildlife behaviors. Pause for a picnic lunch in a scenic spot before continuing your journey through the park’s diverse habitats. As the day winds down, enjoy the breathtaking Serengeti sunset before returning to your lodge for a relaxing evening.
days.overnight: Serengeti central lodge, Matawi serengeti Camp or Similar

days.label: Morning Game Drive and Transfer to Ngorongoro
text: Start your day with a morning game drive in the Serengeti, making the most of the cooler hours when wildlife is most active. This is a great opportunity to spot predators like lions or cheetahs on the move and witness the beauty of the Serengeti one last time.

After the game drive, enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation at Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or a similar lodge, where you can relax and prepare for the next day’s adventure.
days.overnight: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or similar

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater Exploration and Transfer to Karatu
text: Start your day with an exciting journey into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Descend into this vast, natural caldera, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience a thriving ecosystem unlike any other. During your game drive, you’ll have the chance to see a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, elephants, rhinos, and large herds of wildebeest and zebras. Don’t miss the vibrant flocks of flamingos that gather along the shores of the crater’s central lake.

After a memorable day of wildlife encounters, you’ll head out of the crater and drive to the charming Karatu area. Here, you’ll settle in for a restful evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, surrounded by the serene beauty of the countryside. Relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure.

days.label: Departure or Extended Adventures
text: After breakfast, you’ll be transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your journey began, for your departure. Reflect on the incredible experiences and memories you’ve made during your adventure.

For those wishing to extend their trip, there are exciting options available. You can explore nearby attractions through one of the day trips featured on our Day Trip page, offering cultural, scenic, or adventurous activities. Alternatively, you can embark on a Zanzibar excursion, where you’ll enjoy pristine beaches, rich history, and vibrant culture.

If you choose the Zanzibar extension, we’ll arrange your transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar on this same day. Visit our Zanzibar page to discover the perfect package for your next adventure.

title: Tanzania safari and Zanzibar Tours
metaDescription: Embark on a 10-day Tanzania Safari and Zanzibar adventure with Tanzania Wildlife Adventures, offering a combination of wildlife exploration and tropical relaxation. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport, f
overview: Embark on a 10-day Tanzania Safari and Zanzibar adventure with Tanzania Wildlife Adventures, offering a combination of wildlife exploration and tropical relaxation. Your journey begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro or Arusha Airport, followed by visits to Tarangire National Park, Serengeti National Park, Ngorongoro Crater, and Lake Manyara.

These iconic parks offer thrilling game drives, where you’ll witness diverse wildlife, including elephants, lions, cheetahs, and the Great Migration. After your safari, fly to Zanzibar for an enriching cultural experience in Stone Town, and unwind on pristine beaches. Explore the coastline with the Safari Blue Adventure, snorkel in vibrant coral reefs, and enjoy a delicious seafood lunch on a desert island.

This itinerary is fully customizable, allowing you to tailor your trip to your preferences. Whether you’re seeking more wildlife encounters or additional leisure time in Zanzibar, our team is happy to accommodate your requests. From luxury accommodations in Tanzania’s best lodges to the relaxing charm of Zanzibar, we ensure your experience is unforgettable. Book your tailor-made itinerary today for a unique and memorable adventure in Tanzania and Zanzibar.

days.label: Arrival
text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon landing at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, our friendly driver will meet you with a personalized welcome sign and a warm greeting. You’ll then be transferred comfortably to the Salinero Hotel or a similar accommodation.

Later in the day, join our experienced safari coordinators for a pre-safari briefing, where you’ll learn more about the exciting adventures ahead. Unwind and relax in the peaceful surroundings of the hotel, which features amenities like a swimming pool, lush gardens, a bar, and a restaurant. It’s the perfect start to your unforgettable Tanzanian journey!

days.label: Tarangire National Park
text: Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river. The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

days.label: Serengeti national park
text: After breakfast, set off toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. The route takes you through the rugged and beautiful landscapes surrounding the park, giving you glimpses of Maasai villages and the open plains that define this world-famous ecosystem. The Serengeti, known for its vast savannas and the renowned Great Migration, offers a chance to spot a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, cheetahs, elephants, and more.

Arrive in the Serengeti in time for an afternoon game drive, where you can experience the thrill of spotting wildlife against the park’s iconic landscapes. In the evening, unwind and enjoy dinner at your Serengeti Camp, resting up for more exploration the next day.

days.label: Full day in Serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

days.label: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater and Karatu
text: After breakfast, begin your scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, home to the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater. Upon arrival, descend into the crater to witness its incredible wildlife and striking landscapes. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” is teeming with diverse animals, including elephants, lions, rhinos, and flamingos.

After an unforgettable day of exploring the crater, drive to the nearby Karatu area and check into Endoro Lodge or similar, where you can relax and reflect on your remarkable experiences in the heart of Tanzania’s wildlife.

days.label: Lake Manyara National Park and Transfer to Zanzibar
text: Begin your day with breakfast before departing for Lake Manyara National Park, a haven for wildlife enthusiasts. During your game drive, encounter a variety of animals, including elephants, zebras, giraffes, and hippos basking in the park’s waterways. Look out for the iconic tree-climbing lions resting on branches and playful monkeys swinging through the dense forests. Bird lovers will delight in spotting flamingos, pelicans, and colorful kingfishers around the scenic Soda Lake.
In the late afternoon, transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar. Upon arrival, you will be warmly greeted and taken to your hotel, ready to relax and enjoy the island’s serene beauty.

days.label: Explore Stone Town
text: Start your day with a guided tour of Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the cultural heart of Zanzibar. Wander through its narrow streets, lined with historic buildings showcasing a mix of Arab, Indian, and European influences. Visit iconic landmarks such as the House of Wonders, the Old Fort, and the Sultan’s Palace. Discover the vibrant Darajani Market, where local spices, fresh produce, and handcrafted items abound.

Immerse yourself in the island’s rich history and culture as you explore Stone Town’s vibrant atmosphere. After the tour, return to Mahali Zanzibar, where you can unwind and prepare for the next day’s adventures.

days.label: Relax at Leisure
text: Enjoy a full day at your own pace, soaking in the beauty of Zanzibar. Spend your time relaxing on the pristine beaches, taking in the turquoise waters and soft white sands. For those seeking more activity, optional excursions such as snorkeling, diving, or visiting a spice farm can be arranged.
Unwind amidst the serene coastal ambiance, indulging in the hospitality and comfort of Mahali Zanzibar. As the sun sets, savor a delicious dinner and reflect on the tranquil island moments.

days.label: Safari Blue Adventure
text: Spend an exciting day exploring the stunning coastal waters of Zanzibar. Begin your adventure from a quaint fishing village in the southwest of the island, venturing into a bay surrounded by uninhabited islands and pristine sandbanks. Keep an eye out for humpback and bottlenose dolphins that often grace these waters. Snorkel in the vibrant coral reefs, teeming with marine life, and refresh yourself with a green coconut before heading to a desert island for a delightful lunch.

Lunch features a traditional Zanzibar seafood feast, served picnic-style under the shade of tamarind trees. Throughout the day, enjoy a variety of cold drinks, including mineral water, sodas, and beer. Depending on the tides, you may have the opportunity to swim through a serene mangrove lagoon, surrounded by lush forest.
In the evening, return to your lodge to relax and unwind.

days.label: Departure
text: After enjoying a leisurely breakfast, you will have some free time to relax and reflect on your unforgettable experiences in Zanzibar. In the late morning, you will be transferred to Zanzibar Airport in plenty of time for your flight to Dar es Salaam. From there, you will connect to your international departure flight.

We hope your journey with us has been full of memorable moments, from the wildlife adventures in Tanzania to the tropical beauty of Zanzibar. Thank you for choosing Tanzania Wildlife Adventure, and we look forward to welcoming you back on your next adventure. Safe travels and we wish you all the best as you head home!

days.label: Journey to Serengeti National Park
text: After breakfast, you’ll head to Serengeti, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations. The scenic drive takes you through breathtaking landscapes, transitioning into the Serengeti’s vast plains. Along the way, enjoy a game drive where you might spot lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos, and buffalos, often called the “Big Five.”

Cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and many other species add to the thrill of exploring the Serengeti’s rich biodiversity. By evening, you’ll reach the Matawi Serengeti Camp or similar accommodations, where you can relax and enjoy the serene atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot to reflect on the day’s wildlife adventures and prepare for the next.

days.label: Full day in Serengeti
text: Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

days.label: Another Full Day in Serengeti
text: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the Serengeti with another full day of exploration! Begin with an early breakfast before heading out for morning and afternoon game drives across the park’s vast plains. This second day offers a deeper chance to experience the Serengeti’s incredible wildlife, from towering giraffes grazing near acacia trees to cheetahs sprinting across open grasslands.

Your guide will take you to different areas of the park, enhancing your chances of seeing elusive species and observing unique wildlife behaviors. Pause for a picnic lunch in a scenic spot before continuing your journey through the park’s diverse habitats. As the day winds down, enjoy the breathtaking Serengeti sunset before returning to your lodge for a relaxing evening.

days.label: Morning Game Drive and Transfer to Ngorongoro
text: Start your day with a morning game drive in the Serengeti, making the most of the cooler hours when wildlife is most active. This is a great opportunity to spot predators like lions or cheetahs on the move and witness the beauty of the Serengeti one last time.

After the game drive, enjoy a scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Upon arrival, settle into your accommodation at Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or a similar lodge, where you can relax and prepare for the next day’s adventure.
days.overnight: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge, Ngorongoro Wild Camp, or similar

days.label: Ngorongoro Crater Exploration and Transfer to Karatu
text: Start your day with an exciting journey into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Descend into this vast, natural caldera, often called the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” where you’ll experience a thriving ecosystem unlike any other. During your game drive, you’ll have the chance to see a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, elephants, rhinos, and large herds of wildebeest and zebras. Don’t miss the vibrant flocks of flamingos that gather along the shores of the crater’s central lake.

After a memorable day of wildlife encounters, you’ll head out of the crater and drive to the charming Karatu area. Here, you’ll settle in for a restful evening at Endoro Lodge or a similar lodge, surrounded by the serene beauty of the countryside. Relax and prepare for the next leg of your adventure.

days.label: Mto wa Mbu Cultural Experience
text: After breakfast, you’ll embark on a unique cultural experience in Mto wa Mbu, a vibrant village located at the base of the Great Rift Valley. Known for its diverse communities and rich cultural heritage, Mto wa Mbu offers an authentic glimpse into Tanzanian village life. You’ll have the opportunity to explore local markets, interact with artisans, and learn about traditional farming practices. A guided walk through the village will introduce you to the fascinating history and the many ethnic groups that call this area home.

Experience local cuisine, try your hand at traditional crafts, and gain insight into the agricultural methods that sustain the community. After a day of cultural immersion, you’ll be transferred to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar. Upon arrival at Zanzibar Airport, you’ll be picked up and transferred to the Zanzibar Queen Hotel, where you can unwind and enjoy the beautiful surroundings.

days.label: Leisure Day at Zanzibar Queen Hotel
text: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Zanzibar Queen Hotel, preparing for a full day of leisure amidst the stunning natural beauty of Matemwe. This day invites you to bask under the warm sun, enjoy a swim in the turquoise waters, or simply relax by the pool while soaking in views of Mnemba Island in the distance.

For those wanting to explore, take a leisurely walk along the beach, where the soft sand and gentle waves create an idyllic environment for relaxation. As evening falls, enjoy a delightful dinner served at the hotel, where fresh, local ingredients highlight the island’s culinary richness. Fall asleep to the sounds of the ocean, enjoying the peaceful rhythm of Zanzibar’s coastal paradise.

days.label: Free Day with Optional Activities
text: Following breakfast, today is yours to enjoy however you wish, with optional activities or relaxation on offer. For adventure seekers, the nearby Mnemba Atoll promises world-class diving and snorkeling opportunities, with vibrant coral reefs and marine life creating a captivating underwater experience.

Alternatively, stay close to the hotel to enjoy its peaceful beach and amenities or take a calming swim in the resort’s pool. The Matemwe coastline’s gentle ambiance invites you to unwind and explore at your own pace, blending natural beauty with comfort. Complete the day with a delicious dinner back at the hotel, allowing you to savor the flavors of Zanzibar’s cuisine and reflect on a day filled with personal discovery.

days.label: Leisure and Exploration in Matemwe
text: After breakfast, embrace another full day of relaxation or optional explorations around Matemwe. Spend time lounging by the beach or pool, enjoying the hotel’s peaceful atmosphere, or embark on a snorkeling or diving excursion to further explore the vibrant marine life.

For a change of pace, consider venturing into the local village to experience Matemwe’s cultural landscape or relax at the hotel while taking in views of the breathtaking coastline. With dinner included, enjoy a final evening surrounded by Zanzibar’s unique beauty. Each moment captures the island’s calming spirit, making this day a rejuvenating blend of scenic views, cultural interaction, and relaxation, allowing you to unwind fully.

days.label: Stone Town Tour & Departure
text: On your last day, savor a leisurely breakfast before setting off on a half-day tour of Stone Town. Known for its historical significance, this UNESCO World Heritage Site offers a fascinating journey through narrow streets lined with traditional markets, old architecture, and local spice shops. Visit landmarks like the House of Wonders, Darajani Market, and the bustling Forodhani Gardens, each presenting a unique slice of Zanzibar’s cultural heritage.

After exploring Stone Town’s colorful and lively atmosphere, you will be transferred back to Zanzibar Airport for your onward flight. This concluding experience leaves you with cherished memories of Zanzibar’s stunning beauty, enriching culture, and laid-back charm—an unforgettable five-day retreat.

accommodation.name: Sal Salinero Hotel
description: At Salinero Hotels we do not believe in numbers but we do believe in a service keeping our few customers happy around the clock. Salinero Kilimanjaro is Located 3 Km from Moshi town center in the Leafy suburb of shanty town.

The hotel now blends in simplistic elegance with perfect architectural designs all combined to entice even the most seasoned traveller. Now operating as a 30-room unit, we ensure that clients enjoy personalized service around the clock whilst staying with us. Our well manicured gardens provide the ample settings for your wedding reception or any other special event that you may have.

accommodation.name: Endoro Lodge
description: Endoro Lodge is an Eco friendly safari lodge located on the slops of Ngorongoro highland forest. We have beautiful chalet rooms which are uniquely designed to give our clients an authentic African experience. Our highly skilled stuff uphold the slogan which is integrate with nature for they are all dressed in authentic Masai cloths.

accommodation.name: Serengeti Central Lodge
description: Welcome to our enchanting midrange tented camp, a hidden gem in the heart of the Central Serengeti. Our lodge offers a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort, providing a memorable safari experience for our guests. We invite you to embark on a journey of discovery, where the wonders of nature meet the comforts of home for an unforgettable safari getaway.

accommodation.name: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge
description: Ngorongoro Safari Lodge is located in the south of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, approx 50km south-west of karatu Town. The Lodge is composed of 10 comfortable luxury tents to accommodate 2guest each, as well as large dining and reception area. Where is the Ngorongoro Conservation Area? The Ngorongoro Conservation Area spans vast expanses of highland plains, savanna, savanna woodlands, and forests.

accommodation.name: Ngorongoro Wild Camp
description: Ngorongoro Wild Camp is located in the South of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Approx. 50 km south – west of Karatu Town. The permanent camp is composed of 20 comfortable luxury tents and 6 cottages, as well as large dining and reception area.

The unique and comfortable Ngorongoro Wild Camps offer Various contemporary amenities such as Dining & Bar Activities, internet, Sundowner cocktails to Bush meals at a private site, fireplace, Maasai barbecue, Ngorongoro Multi-cuisine restaurant provide a memorable wild experience.

accommodation.name: Zanzibar Queen Hotel
description: Located on one of the most beautiful coral beaches in the world – Matemwe, Zanzibar Queen Hotel is a true gem among other Zanzibar’s resorts. Proximity of Mnemba attracts amateur and professional divers. With its exquisite cuisine and unique service our Hotel can guarantee unforgetable experiences. Our hotel has 31 luxurious double deluxe rooms and 3 brand new beach-front bungalows, perfect for honeymooners. They are the place where comfort, exoticism, modernity and diversity meet.
